items.titleEn: Nottingham Forest 0-1 Arsenal: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: A late, deflected winner from Noni Madueke gave Arsenal a vital win in a low-quality game, Forest then missing two good chances to equaliseForest will want – and probably need – to make this game a mess. If it’s open and played through midfield, Arsenal will open them up because, with the guile they’ve added by buying Guimaraes, along with an in-form Odegaard, they have the ability to exploit space. For that reason, Forest need bodies everywhere, especially in the middle of the pitch, forcing them wide, where Saka might just’ve lost the spring in his acceleration following last season’s achilles injury while, on the other side, Eze isn’t going to go on the outside.Elsewhere, 10-man Sunderland trail Bournemouth 2-0 with seconds remaining, while Brighton have splattered Palace 5-0 to move second above Arsenal, their goal difference +18. Ridiculous behaviour. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Aha, David Hytner’s match report is here.
Which means that’s it from me. Thanks for your company and comments; peace out.

That was a huge win for Arsenal, who won’t have wanted to fall further behind City. They won’t get away with playing like that every week – Madueke’s deflected winner was their first shot on target – but they won’t. Arteta does, though, need to find a better attacking balance, and trying Eze against a low block makes some kind of sense, but I’m afraid it looks like it won’t work for him at Arsenal.
Also going on:
“Fresh” in that it wasn’t quite smelly enough to be off, but it really wasn’t far away.
Madueke thanks his lord and saviour Jesus Christ, to whom goes the glory, then praises Arsenal’s determination, saying they’ve struggled at Forest the last few season.

With the goal, he felt he’d beaten his man on the outside a few times so decided to go inside and thank God it went in, then it’s more praise for God, and off he goes, collecting his player of the match award and smiling broadly.
It took a spawny winner, but Arsenal showed why they’re champions. Forest made poor decisions at crucial moments, but defended well.
90+4 min The corner comes in, the whistle goes for an infringement of some sort, and that’ll be it.

90+3 min More Murillo! He sends a terrific pass in behind, inside-left channel, and Delap is on to it, Timber in pursuit. Into the box he barrels, and he’s got to shoot, but he takes one more touch that allows the defender to slide in and block behind. If he goes earlier, he’s a little further out, but that doesn’t happen.

90+2 min Oh my days! Out on the left, Murillo espies opportunity, suddenly banging the ball between Konsa and Timber and exploding on to it, flying into the box. Rice looks to show him outside so he leans that way then Brazilians studs over the ball inside! The shot is on, he tries a curler … and it zooms just over the angle.
90 min We’ll have three additional minutes.

89 min With Forest boxed, Arsenal go down the left, Madueke’s cross overrun by Calfiori. But then Forest counter and, when Delap wins a throw, he takes it instantly, sending Hudson-Odoi away! With Wood in the middle, this is the chance! So Hudson-Odoi draws his man then squares, but his mate’s first touch takes him into traffic, he makes it worse by continuing in that direction, and his shot is blocked at source. Excellent play until the crucial moment, then every action and decision was the wrong one.

88 min Arsenal have played well since scoring, managing the game by keeping the ball inside the Forest half. They win a free-kick which Rice swings into the box, Murillo heading out; the throw goes short, and the ball is kept.

86 min I guess Hudson-Odoi is a victim of Glasner’s preferred formation, but he’s too good to be sat at the side for 85 minutes. I wonder if he might be able to do something as one of the 10s, because he’s a much better footballer than Ndoye and McAtee, and might dovetail well with Gibbs-White in that role.
85 min Two changes for Forest, Hudson-Odoi and Wood on for Cunha and McAtee.
84 min Arsenal disappear time, slowing down the play – something which felt impossible given the treacley nature of what we’ve been watching. Forest need to get in among them.
82 min Can Forest shift mindset to respond? They’re going to bring on Chris Wood when there’s a break in play, but Arsenal are expert in navigating a rearguard.

That kind of goal! Madueke picks up the ball a little further inside, rather than on the touchline he’s been sitting on. He runs at Munoz, twisting him up to create a shooting angle, lacing one hard that Sels should fish out at the near post, except a deflection off Cunha takes it past him near the far. When your champions, these are the things that go for you.
79 min More Arsenal crosses, more Forest clearances. I don’t think I understand what kind of goal Artetz wants his men to score, beyond a header or from a scramble.

78 min Forest sit back and Arsenal move the ball from side to side, but with no zip. Then, when Madeueke’s cross is deflected, Murillo heads clear, before Saka’s cross from way out is collected by Sels.
76 min …which Odegaard swings into the nearest forehead. This is desperately poor stuff.

75 min That Rice chance was the best Arsenal have created all match and they might yet nick it, but I can’t help but feel the changes made have lacked a little bit imagination, as Wenger might say, As things stand, they’ve yet top have a shot on target, something they’ve not managed across a 90 in five years. They do, though, have a free-kick out on the right…
74 min Changes for Forest, Kalimuendo and Sangare for Ndoye and Dominguez.

72 min Suddenly Arsenal inject pace, Saka drawing two men then passing between them for Odegaard, who turns first-time into space for Timber – the kind of triangulation that opens tight defences. Timber cuts back well too, Rice having arrived into the box, but his swept finish is too high.

69 min Schlager to Delap, who collects well and bulldozes between the Arsenal centre-backs. But mistrustful of his pace, he doesn’t sticks the ball through the gap and charge after it, instead shooting from 20 yards, the kind of effort that needs to be special to go in … which it isn’t and doesn’t.
68 min Timber’s first, er, action is to concede a corner, Raya coming for the corner and collecting well.

67 min On those changes, I like Timber and Merino, but I’d have gone for Lewis-Skelly as well; the players who’ve come on make it seem like Arsenal are just hoping for a ball into the box to work out well.
66 min Before the corner, a triple change for Arsenal: Timber, Merino and Gyokeres for White, Guimaraes and Havert, then the corner comes in and Gabriel heads high over the bar.

65 min Now Arsenal attack, Madueke again keeping the width and winning a corner. I’m not surprised Merino is stripping off, because he might at least threaten from set-pieces. Meantime, McAtee panics when the ball looks to be dropping for Odegaard just outside the box, hitchkicking behind from 20 yards out.

63 min Murillo releases Ndoye, who doesn’t quite have the pace to get rid of Gabriel. But he is ahead of him with runners, opting to check inside, which allows the defender to get back properly, blocking the shot at source.

62 min Sels comes and punches the corner clear, then Odegaard’s pass in behind is too strong for Calafiori. I wonder if Arteta might try Dowman, because he needs a bit of something different; I’d go Lews-Skelly for Rice or Guimaraes, because he has the ability the commit men in the middle of the pitch, beating them with skill or bouncing them with power.
61 min Calafiori finds Madueke, whose low cross is deflected behind. This time, as it’s from the left, Rice will take the corner.
60 min Raya comes for the corner and collects well, setting away a counter moved on by a lovely Saka touch. For all the good it does anyone, Madueke swiftly ceding possession.
59 min McAtee’s ball bounces through the box and eventually goes behind on the other side; Forest are building a bit of territorial pressure.

58 min Williams collects a loose ball and slides square, but Guimaraes gets the ahead of Dominguez, then Munoz wins a corner down the right. Forest have been the better team so far this half, little though that’s saying.

56 min This game and Leeds v Man United have been proper 80s fare, bodies everywhere and very little quality or composure. The physicality is a little different – violence is harder to perpetrate but compensated for with athleticism – and the result is a mess. I’d expect to see many more games like this, especially as, despite the money available, the very best attackers tend not to play in England.
55 min …which Munoz clears at the near post, then there’s a quick VAR check for handball, nothing doing.
54 min Immediately, Saka bounces down the other end and wins a corner for Arsenal…
53 min Cunha lanks through midfield and finds “Delap!” But no joy for Drury, his shot deflected behind for a corner which comes to nothing.
53 min Madueke weaves in off the left, shoots … directly into the nearest shins then, when Dominguez turns White, he runs through him and is booked.
51 min This game has been almost entirely devoid of quality; in that regard, it might be the worst I’ve seen this season.
50 min Forest have started the second half well and Delap outmuscles Gabriel on the right, then belts a cross to no one.

items.titleZh: 诺丁汉森林 0-1 阿森纳：英超联赛实况
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯替补建功，阿森纳在客场艰难击败诺丁汉森林全取三分。
bodyZh: 大卫·海特纳的比赛报告已经出炉。
这意味着我的直播到此结束。感谢您的陪伴与评论，再见。
对于阿森纳来说这是一场极为重要的胜利，他们可不想在积分榜上被曼城进一步拉开。他们不可能每周都靠这种表现过关——马杜埃凯折射进球是他们全场唯一一次射正——但至少今天他们做到了。阿尔特塔确实需要找到更好的进攻平衡，尝试让埃泽面对密集防守在某种程度上可以理解，但恐怕这并不适合目前的阿森纳。
同时进行的比赛：
“新鲜”的意思是它还没臭到不能要的地步，但也差不远了。
马杜埃凯感谢了他的救世主耶稣基督并将其荣耀归于神，随后赞扬了阿森纳的斗志，并表示他们在过去几个赛季在森林的主场踢得都很艰难。
关于那个进球，他觉得自己在外线过人几次后决定内切，感谢上帝这球打进了。他接着表达了对上帝的赞美，随后开心地拿下了全场最佳球员奖。
这虽然是一个幸运的制胜球，但阿森纳展现了他们为什么是冠军。森林在关键时刻做出了糟糕的选择，但防守表现不错。
第90+4分钟 角球开出，裁判吹罚了某种犯规，比赛就此结束。
第90+3分钟 穆里略又来了！他送出一记精彩的过顶直塞到左肋部，德拉普高速插上，廷贝尔在身后紧追不舍。他带球杀入禁区必须起脚射门了，但他多带了一步，导致防守球员得以滑铲将球挡出底线。如果他早点射门，距离可能会稍远一些，但并没有如果。
第90+2分钟 我的天哪！穆里略在左路敏锐地发现战机，突然从孔萨和廷贝尔之间强行突入禁区。赖斯试图逼他走外线，但他假动作晃过随后用脚尖将球扣向内侧！他起脚兜射……皮球稍稍高出横梁。
第90分钟 比赛将进行3分钟的补时。
第89分钟 森林全线退守，阿森纳打到左路，马杜埃凯的传中被卡拉菲奥里错过。随后森林反击，德拉普赢得一个界外球并迅速主罚，将球传给奥多伊！中路有伍德接应，这是一个绝佳机会！于是奥多伊吸引防守后横传，但队友的第一下触球却带入了人堆，随后他继续盲目突破让情况变得更糟，射门在第一时间被封堵。关键时刻之前的配合堪称完美，但随后的每一个动作和决定都是错的。
第88分钟 阿森纳进球后踢得不错，通过将球控制在森林的半场来掌控比赛。他们赢得一个任意球，赖斯将球吊入禁区，穆里略头球解围；随后短传配合稳稳控住球权。
第86分钟 我猜奥多伊是格拉斯纳偏爱阵型的受害者，但他实力太强，不应该在场边枯坐85分钟。我想他或许可以胜任双十号位之一的角色，因为他比恩多耶和麦卡蒂是更好的球员，并且在这个位置上可能与吉布斯-怀特产生很好的化学反应。
第85分钟 森林做出两次换人调整，奥多伊和伍德替补登场换下库尼亚和麦卡蒂。
第84分钟 阿森纳在拖延时间，放慢比赛节奏——考虑到我们之前看到的沉闷场面，这似乎是不可能发生的。森林需要压迫他们。
第82分钟 森林能调整心态做出回应吗？比赛暂停时他们将换上克里斯·伍德，但阿森纳在处理后防线危机时经验老道。
就是那种进球！马杜埃凯这次在中路稍微靠里的位置拿球，而不是一直待在边线旁。他带球冲向穆尼奥斯，通过变向晃出射门角度，随后轰出一记势大力沉的射门，瑟尔斯本应在近门柱将球扑出，奈何皮球击中库尼亚发生折射飞入远角。当你是冠军时，运气往往会站在你这边。
第79分钟 阿森纳不断的传中，森林不断的解围。除了头顶或者混战破门，我实在看不出阿尔特塔到底想让他的队员们进什么样的球。
第78分钟 森林回收防守，阿森纳耐心地左右倒脚，但缺乏速度。随后，马杜埃凯的传中被折射，穆里略头球解围，萨卡随后自远处的传中被瑟尔斯没收。
第76分钟……厄德高开出角球直接送到最近的防守队员头上。这表现实在太糟糕了。
第75分钟 赖斯之前的那个机会是阿森纳全场创造出的最好机会，他们或许还能偷走一场胜利，但我不得不说这些换人缺乏一点想象力，正如温格所说。就目前而言，他们甚至还没完成过一次射正，这在他们长达五年的90分钟比赛里从未出现过。不过，他们在右侧获得了一个任意球……
第74分钟 森林换人，卡利穆恩多和桑加雷换下恩多耶和多明格斯。
第72分钟 阿森纳突然提速，萨卡吸引两人防守后将球从两人中间塞给厄德高，后者顺势将球做给空当处的廷贝尔——正是这种三角配合撕开了密防。廷贝尔倒三角回传也很到位，赖斯拍马赶到禁区内包抄，但他的推射打高了。
第69分钟 施拉格将球传给德拉普，后者拿球强行从阿森纳中卫之间强行生趟。但由于对自己速度缺乏信心，他没有把球趟大然后加速狂奔，而是在20码外仓促远射，这种射门需要极其精彩才能进……显然这球既不精彩也没进。
第68分钟 廷贝尔的第一次，呃，防守动作是送出一个角球，拉亚出击将角球稳稳摘下。
第67分钟 说到换人，我喜欢廷贝尔和梅里诺，但我也会选择派上刘易斯-斯凯利；换上场的这些球员让人感觉阿森纳只是在寄希望于一脚传中能碰运气进球。
第66分钟 角球开出之前，阿森纳进行了一次三人换人调整：廷贝尔、梅里诺和哲凯赖什替补登场换下怀特、吉马良斯和哈弗茨，随后角球开出，加布里埃尔头球顶高。
第65分钟 阿森纳卷土重来，马杜埃凯再次拉开宽度并赢得一个角球。看到梅里诺在场边脱下外套我并不感到意外，因为他至少能在定位球中制造威胁。与此同时，麦卡蒂看到皮球落向禁区边缘的厄德高时显得有些惊慌失措，在20码外将球解围出底线。
第63分钟 穆里略传球给恩多耶，但他的速度稍欠未能彻底甩开加布里埃尔。由于身前有队友接应，他选择急停内切，这让防守球员得以从容回防并在第一时间封堵了射门。
第62分钟 瑟尔斯出击双拳将角球击出，随后厄德高直塞力量稍大，卡拉菲奥里没能追上。我想阿尔特塔或许可以尝试一下道曼，因为球队需要一些不一样的变化；我也会用刘易斯-斯凯利换下赖斯或吉马良斯，因为他具备在中路盘带过人或利用身体对抗强突的能力。
第61分钟 卡拉菲奥里找到马杜埃凯，后者的低平球传中被折射出底线。这一次由于是从左侧发起，将由赖斯来罚角球。
第60分钟 拉亚出击摘下角球，并通过萨卡的一次精彩触球迅速发动反击。然而对大局毫无帮助的是，马杜埃凯很快又把球权弄丢了。
第59分钟 麦卡蒂的传球在禁区内弹地而过后最终从另一侧出了底线；森林正在建立一些区域压迫优势。
第58分钟 威廉姆斯截下散落的球并横敲，但吉马良斯抢在多明格斯之前解围，随后穆尼奥斯在右路赢得角球。森林在下半场表现得更好，尽管这也没什么好吹嘘的。
第57分钟 这场比赛和利兹联对阵曼联的比赛简直是标准的80年代英式风格，满场飞奔却极度缺乏技术含量和沉着。身体对抗有些不同——暴力动作减少了，取而代之的是身体素质的对抗——结果就是一片混乱。我预计未来还会看到更多这样的比赛，尤其是尽管投入巨大，但最顶级的攻击手往往并不在英格兰踢球。
第56分钟……穆尼奥斯在近门柱解围，随后VAR迅速检查了手球嫌疑，认定没有问题。
第55分钟 萨卡随即在另一端带球突破，为阿森纳赢得一个角球……
第54分钟 库尼亚在中路大步流星推进并找到了“德拉普！”但德鲁伊未能如愿，他的射门被折射出底线送给对手一个角球，最终无功而返。
第53分钟 马杜埃凯从左路内切起脚射门……直接闷在最近防守队员的胫骨上；随后当多明格斯转身过掉怀特时，怀特将其放倒并吃到黄牌。
第51分钟 这场比赛几乎完全缺乏技术含量；从这个角度来看，它可能是我本赛季看过最烂的一场比赛。
第50分钟 森林下半场开局不错，德拉普在右路凭借身体优势扛住加布里埃尔，随后强行传中却无人接应。

bodyEn: The theme before kick-off was blanks. Or, more precisely, whether either team could stop firing them at the City Ground. It is a detail to make Oliver Glasner extremely uncomfortable that his Nottingham Forest team had still to score at their home stadium. Arsenal, meanwhile, had drawn 0-0 on each of their previous two visits to this part of the East Midlands.

Forest’s frustrations under their new manager go on. It was another spirited performance from them, bits to like, especially a full throttle performance from Liam Delap in the No 9 position. But, for the fifth time under Glasner in all competitions, there was not a goal to celebrate in front of the club’s home fans.

It was a game that came to feel increasingly set up for the famous terrace chant. One-nil to the Ars-en-nal. Or, as the travelling hordes would have it, one-nil to the champions. Arsenal did not play well. They created little, finishing with just one shot of target. How Noni Madueke made it count.

On as a half-time substitute, the winger took a pass from Declan Rice in the 80th minute and had only one thing on his mind. To cut inside from the left and unload. The connection was pure and that was when he caught a break, which he has worked to earn after a difficult start to the season. The ball deflected off Jair Cunha and flew past the Forest goalkeeper, Matz Sels.

Forest refused to accept the inevitable. Chris Wood, on as a substitute, delayed too long and saw Rice block. Murillo, all of all players, danced inside from the left and curled just off target. And Delap was denied at the death by a thunderous Ezri Konsa block tackle. But it did feel inevitable. Arsenal had not forgotten their previous away fixture – the 3-0 defeat at Brighton. It remains the only blot on their season.

Arsenal had kicked off six points behind Manchester City, who have been perfect on the field in the league this season. Will it matter when the sanctions for their rule breaches are meted out? All Arsenal can do is play the situation as it stands and there was a boost for them here when the teamsheets dropped, which was about the same time that Morgan Gibbs-White was driving his Porsche into the stadium car park. Forest’s key attacking midfielder missed out with a calf injury. He was a big miss.

Glasner said that shooting practice had been a major part of his training sessions during the week and how the home crowd wanted to see something from their team in front of goal. The game was framed from a Forest point of view by the extraordinary number of openings they had blown in the 3-1 defeat at Crystal Palace last weekend; they had eight big chances, according to the statisticians. They were never going to get anything like that number against Arsenal.

Arteta’s team hogged the ball. As they were always likely to do. Bruno Guimarães looked to push up at the outset and combine with Martin Ødegaard, who occupied the No 10 position. Rice was the nominal holding midfielder. Arsenal were determined to be patient but it was flat and predictable from them before the interval. The lack of incisive movement was glaring. That said, Forest were compact out of possession in what was a 5-4-1 formation and hard to break down. They were resolved not to give up any easy yards.

Arsenal played their patterns. They tried to suck the life out of the home crowd, working on the principle that it is difficult for fans to get animated if their team do not have the ball. The first half drifted by in a lazy Sunday afternoon haze, no shots on target for either side.

Delap carried the physical fight; the Forest centre-forward was a willing and direct runner and he won a free-kick off Rice just outside the Arsenal box on 44 minutes. Nico Williams thumped it at Guimarães, who went down stayed down. The Forest support were unhappy at what they perceived as Arsenal’s use of the dark arts. “Are you City in disguise?” they chanted.

Could a set-piece provide the breakthrough? It felt like the likeliest route. Murillo headed wide from a Forest corner in the 20th minute and was bloodied into the bargain; there was a whistle for a foul in the mass of bodies inside the six-yard box. At the other end, Kai Havertz headed over from a Rice free-kick on 37 minutes. He had a decent look at the ball and was well-placed. It was a good chance.

Arsenal have been a little barren in first halves this season. This was the seventh time in 10 matches since the Community Shield that they had failed to score. It has not been a problem. They needed to raise their levels for the second-half.

Arteta’s first change was Madueke for Eberechi Eze on the left wing; an admission that the latter had failed to exert an influence. There was also a triple substitution on 66 minutes, the Arsenal manager sending on Jurrien Timber, Mikel Merino and Viktor Gyökeres for Ben White, Guimarães and Havertz. He needed to shake things up because nothing was happening for his team. It was Forest who pushed after the restart, with Delap continuing to put himself about. He asked questions of Gabriel Magalhães, albeit the Arsenal defender tended to have the answers.

The minutes ticked down, the contest narrowing to a fine point and we waited to see whether there could be a moment, one big chance. Ødegaard almost provided it in the 72nd minute when he released Timber with a lovely pass up the inside right. When Timber pulled back, Rice lifted wastefully high.

Glasner’s decision to introduce Ibrahim Sangaré for Dan Ndoye shortly afterwards was telling. Sangaré’s mission was to bolster the Forest midfield and yet he was slow to react to a half-cleared ball. When Rice played the pass, Madueke took over.

items.titleZh: 马杜埃凯打破诺丁汉森林防线，坚韧阿森纳险胜
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯替补登场打入制胜球，阿森纳在客场艰难击败诺丁汉森林。
bodyZh: 开球前的主题是进球荒。或者更准确地说，双方能否在城市球场打破僵局。奥利弗·格拉斯纳的诺丁汉森林队在主场依然未能取得进球，这让他感到非常尴尬。与此同时，阿森纳此前两次来到东米德兰兹郡作客时，都以0-0战平。
森林在新帅带领下的沮丧仍在继续。他们的表现依然充满斗志，有许多令人喜爱的地方，特别是利亚姆·德拉普在9号位置上的全情投入。但在格拉斯纳麾下的各项赛事中，这是他们第五次在主场球迷面前未能庆祝进球。
这场比赛越来越让人想起那首著名的看台歌谣：阿森纳一比零。或者用客场球迷的话说，冠军一比零。阿森纳踢得并不好。他们创造的机会寥寥无几，全场只有一次射正。然而马杜埃凯让这次射门转化为了进球。
这名边锋在半场替补登场，他在第80分钟接到德克兰·赖斯的传球后，脑子里只有一个想法：从左路内切并起脚射门。这脚击球非常纯粹，他也借此运气取得了进球，在经历了艰难的赛季开局后，这是他努力应得的回报。皮球打在雅伊尔·库尼亚身上发生折射，飞过了森林门将马茨·塞尔斯的十指关。
森林拒绝接受既定结局。替补登场的克里斯·伍德犹豫太久，眼睁睁看着赖斯完成封堵。穆里略从左路内切并兜射稍稍偏出。而德拉普在临终前的一次绝佳射门被埃兹里·孔萨神勇封堵。但这一切似乎又是注定的。阿森纳没有忘记他们上一个客场比赛——客场0-3不敌布莱顿。那仍然是他们本赛季唯一的污点。
阿森纳开球时落后领头羊曼城6分，曼城本赛季在联赛中表现完美。当针对曼城违规行为的制裁出台时，这还重要吗？阿森纳能做的只有按现状踢好比赛，当首发名单公布时，他们迎来了一个利好消息，当时摩根·吉布斯-怀特正开着他的保时捷驶入球场停车场。森林的关键进攻中场因小腿受伤缺阵，他的缺席是一个巨大损失。
格拉斯纳表示，射门练习是本周训练课的重要部分，主场球迷多么渴望看到球队在门前有所斩获。上周末在客场1-3不敌水晶宫的比赛中，森林创造了惊人的破门良机，据统计他们有8次绝佳机会；他们本场对阵阿森纳时绝不可能获得如此多的机会。
阿尔特塔的球队掌控了球权。正如大家预料的那样。布鲁诺·吉马良斯在开场时试图压上，并与占据10号位的马丁·厄德高串联。赖斯则是名义上的防守型中场。阿森纳决心保持耐心，但在中场休息前，他们的进攻显得沉闷且可以预测。缺乏穿透性的跑动十分明显。话虽如此，森林在无球状态下排出了5-4-1的紧凑阵型，极难被攻破。他们决心不轻易给对手任何空间。
阿森纳按照套路踢球。他们试图抽干主场球迷的热情，其逻辑在于，如果对手没有球权，球迷就很难兴奋起来。上半场在懒洋洋的周日下午雾气中缓缓流逝，双方均无射正。
德拉普承担了身体对抗的重任；这位森林中锋跑动积极且直接，他在第44分钟在阿森纳禁区外从赖斯脚下赢得了一个任意球。尼科·威廉姆斯将球轰向吉马良斯，后者倒地不起。森林球迷对他们认为阿森纳在运用“黑暗艺术”的行为感到不满。他们高唱：“你们是曼城的替身吗？”
订阅《每日足球》
用卫报的视角开启您的足球之夜
通讯推广后
定位球能打破僵局吗？这似乎是最有可能的途径。第20分钟，穆里略在森林队的角球进攻中头球顶偏，还在拼抢中挂了彩；小禁区内的一群人中传出了犯规的哨响。而在另一端，第37分钟，凯·哈弗茨接赖斯的任意球头球顶高。他看准了落点且位置很好。这是一次不错的机会。
本赛季阿森纳在上半场的表现有些贫瘠。自社区盾杯以来的10场比赛中，这是他们第七次在上半场未能进球。这并不是什么大问题。他们需要在下半场提升水平。
阿尔特塔的第一次换人是用马杜埃凯换下左路的埃贝雷奇·埃泽；这承认了后者未能发挥影响力。在第66分钟，他还做出了一次三人换人调整，阿森纳主帅派上尤里恩·廷贝尔、米克尔·梅里诺和维克托·哲凯赖什，换下本·怀特、吉马良斯和哈弗茨。他必须做出改变，因为他的球队毫无起色。反而是森林在下半场开局后持续施压，德拉普继续不知疲倦地拼搏。他给加布里埃尔·马加良斯制造了麻烦，尽管这位阿森纳后卫总能给出答案。
时间一分一秒流逝，比赛收窄至关键时刻，我们都在等待是否会有一个时刻、一个绝佳机会的出现。第72分钟，厄德高送出一记精妙的右肋直塞，险些创造进球，他放出了廷贝尔。当廷贝尔回传时，赖斯将球高高踢飞，浪费了机会。
不久之后，格拉斯纳换上易卜拉欣·桑加雷替下丹·恩多耶，这一决定意味深长。桑加雷的任务是加强森林的中场，然而面对一个被解围了一半的球，他反应迟缓。当赖斯送出传球时，马杜埃凯接管了比赛。

items.summaryEn: The story of our Premier League victory at the City Ground
bodyEn: Nottingham Forest 0-1 Arsenal
Noni Madueke’s second-half goal gave us a hard-fought win in a close encounter away to Nottingham Forest.
Our last two trips to The City Ground had ended goalless, and this one looked to be heading the same way before Madueke’s deflected strike 10 minutes from time.
The first half contained little goalmouth action for either team. In fact neither side had a shot on target in the opening 45 minutes.
The second-half was played out in a similar vein – Declan Rice skying our best chance inside the area – before half-time sub Madueke struck.
Forest had three big chances at the death, the last of them quashed when Ezri Konsa made a huge block to deny Liam Delap when the striker was through on goal.
GOALLESS FIRST HALF

We completely dominated the ball in the opening 15 minutes, enjoying 80 per cent possession, but weren’t able to work it into the right areas to hurt Forest. The play was condensed in the middle of the park with the hosts working hard to get men behind the ball and look for opportunities on the counter.

There were 20 minutes on the clock before either side had an attempt on goal. Riccardo Calafiori gave the ball away near the halfway line, and after we only half cleared a cross, Dan Ndoye’s low shot was tipped round the post for a corner.
The closest we came in the opening half hour was a scramble inside the six-yard box from a corner, but Gabriel’s improvised backheel was blocked.
As a fairly sterile first half drew to a close, Kai Havertz headed a free-kick over then ran onto an Odegaard throughball but hit the side-netting.
FRUSTRATIONS CONTINUE
Mikel Arteta introduced Madueke into the action for the second half, replacing Eberechi Eze on the left.

We were still unable to create much going forward though, and as the afternoon wore on it was the home team who increasingly looked dangerous, with Liam Delap occupying our defenders well, and looking dangerous from set pieces.
Arteta again turned to his bench, bringing on Mikel Merino, Viktor Gyokeres and Jurrien Timber – the latter for his 100th Arsenal appearance.
It injected some energy. Gabriel got up well to an inswinging Rice corner but headed over before we created our best opening of the game.
Odegaard found Timber on the overlap, he burst into the area and cut back for Rice, but he blasted his shot over the bar when well placed.
NONI KNICKS IT

As we moved into the final 15 minutes we started to put the hosts under pressure, and finally broke the deadlock thanks to Madueke’s deflected effort. Rice spread the pass out to the England man on the left, he cut into the box before firing goalwards, and a diversion off Jair Cunha helped the ball fly past Matz Sels.
The away section at The City Ground erupted.
Forest generated three big chances in the final three minutes.
First Chris Wood was free in the box after some quick thinking at a Forest throw led to a counter attack, but Rice got back well to block the shot.
Next defender Murilo tricked his way into the box, dragged the ball past his man, before curling just over.
Then the last action of the game saw Delap streak through on goal, only to be denied by a superb sliding challenge from Konsa.
We had done enough though to make it six wins out of seven to start the Premier League season.
WHAT’S NEXT
We head to Germany in midweek for our Champions League match away to Bayern Munich on Wednesday evening, before resuming our Premier League campaign at home to Everton next Saturday.

items.titleZh: 赛况：诺丁汉森林 0-1 阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯破门，阿森纳客场1-0小胜诺丁汉森林。
bodyZh: 诺丁汉森林 0-1 阿森纳
马杜埃凯在下半场的进球让我们在客场对阵诺丁汉森林的艰苦较量中艰难取胜。
我们过去两次造访城市球场都以零比零收场，在马杜埃凯距离比赛结束还有十分钟时的折射破门之前，这场比赛看起来也将朝着相同的方向发展。
上半场双方在门前都没有太多威胁，事实上在前45分钟里双方都没有射正。
下半场的比赛进程与上半场相似——德克兰·赖斯在禁区内错失了我们最好的机会将球射飞——随后中场替补登场的马杜埃凯取得了进球。
森林队在比赛尾声阶段获得了三次绝佳机会，最后一次机会被埃兹里·孔萨通过关键封堵化解，当时对方锋线球员利亚姆·德拉普已经单刀直入。
上半场互交白卷
我们在开场的前十五分钟完全掌控了球权，控球率高达百分之八十，但未能将球传到能够对森林队造成杀伤的区域。比赛主要在中场展开，主队球员努力全员防守并寻找反击机会。
比赛进行了二十分钟，双方才产生第一次射门。里卡多·卡拉菲奥里在中场附近丢球，我们在勉强解围了一次传中后，丹·恩多耶的低射被扑出底线获得角球。
在前三十分钟里我们最接近进球的一次是利用角球在六码区内引发混战，但加布里埃尔随性的脚后跟射门被封堵。
随着相对沉闷的上半场接近尾声，凯·哈弗茨接任意球头球顶高，随后接厄德高直塞却击中边网。
挫折仍在继续
米克尔·阿尔特塔在下半场换上了马杜埃凯，换下了左路的埃贝雷奇·埃泽。
尽管如此，我们在进攻端依然无法创造出太多机会，随着比赛的推移，反倒是主队看起来越来越危险，利亚姆·德拉普很好地牵制了我们的后卫，并在定位球上制造了威胁。
阿尔特塔再次调兵遣将，换上了米克尔·梅里诺、维克托·哲凯赖什以及尤里延·廷贝尔——后者迎来了他在阿森纳的第100次出场。
这注入了一些活力。加布里埃尔接赖斯开出的旋转角球高高跃起头球顶高，随后我们创造了全场最佳机会。
厄德高找到了前插的廷贝尔，后者杀入禁区并倒三角回传给赖斯，但位置极佳的赖斯将球射高。
马杜埃凯一击制胜
进入最后十五分钟后，我们开始对主队施加压力，并凭借马杜埃凯的折射进球打破了僵局。赖斯将球分到左路的英格兰国脚脚下，他内切进入禁区起脚射门，皮球经雅伊尔·库尼亚折射后飞越马茨·塞尔斯把守的大门。
城市球场的客队球迷区瞬间沸腾。
森林队在最后三分钟创造了三次绝佳机会。
首先是克里斯·伍德在禁区内无人盯防，此前森林队一次快速的手抛球发起反击，但赖斯及时回防封堵了射门。
接着后卫穆里略通过盘带闯入禁区，晃过防守球员后兜射稍稍高出横梁。
随后比赛的最后时刻，德拉普单刀直入，但被孔萨通过一次精彩的滑铲化解。
不过我们已经做到了足够的事情，在新赛季英格兰足球超级联赛开局阶段取得了七战六胜的成绩。
接下来
我们将在周中前往德国，于周三晚上客场挑战拜仁慕尼黑进行欧洲冠军联赛比赛，随后于下周六回到英超赛场主场迎战埃弗顿。

items.titleEn: Team news: Havertz, Saka and Odegaard return v Forest
items.summaryEn: Find out our starting XI to take on Nottingham Forest at the City Ground
bodyEn: Bukayo Saka, Kai Havertz and skipper Martin Odegaard are among five changes the boss has made to the team to face Nottingham Forest on Sunday.
Ben White and Riccardo Calafiori are the other two players to be recalled for the Premier League match at the City Ground, after neither started our midweek home win over Lille.
It means Eberechi Eze retains his place to make his first Premier League start of the season.
Martin Zubimendi has recovered from injury to take his place on the bench, and Jurrien Timber is also among the subs. If the Dutchman comes on in will be his 100th Gunners appearance.
Substitute goalkeeper Illan Meslier is also named in the squad as Kepa Arrizabalaga is ruled out with injury.

The hosts lost 3-1 away to Crystal Palace last weekend, and make two changes from that side - Morgan Gibbs-White misses out with injury while Ola Aina drops to the bench. In come Nicolas Dominguez and Jair Cunha.
LINE-UPS
Arsenal: Raya, White, Gabriel, Konsa, Calafiori, Rice, Guimaraes, Odegaard, Eze, Saka, Havertz.Subs: Meslier, Timber, Lewis-Skelly, Mosquera, Zubimendi, Merino, Madueke, Dowman, Gyokeres.
Nottingham Forest: Sels, Murillo, Diomande, Dominguez, Williams, Munoz, Schlager, McAtee, Cunha, Ndoye, Delap.Subs: Victor, Sangare, Hudson-Odoi, Kalimuendo, Yates, Netz, Milenkovic, Aina, Wood.

items.summaryZh: 查看客场对阵诺丁汉森林的首发阵容
bodyZh: 萨卡、哈弗茨和队长厄德高是主教练为周日对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛所做出的人员调整中的五处变化之一。
本·怀特和卡拉菲奥里是这场英超客场比赛中另外两名重回首发的球员，此前他们都没有在周中主场战胜里尔的比赛中首发。
这意味着埃泽保留了他的位置，迎来了他本赛季的首场英超首发。
祖比门迪已从伤病中恢复并进入替补席，廷贝尔也在替补阵容中。如果这位荷兰球员登场，这将是他在枪手的第100次出场。
由于凯帕因伤缺阵，替补门将梅利耶也进入了大名单。
主队上周末在客场1-3不敌水晶宫，本场比赛他们做出了两处人员调整——吉布斯-怀特因伤缺阵，奥拉·阿伊纳则进入替补席。尼古拉斯·多明格斯和雅伊尔·库尼亚首发出场。
首发阵容
阿森纳：拉亚、怀特、加布里埃尔、孔萨、卡拉菲奥里、赖斯、吉马良斯、厄德高、埃泽、萨卡、哈弗茨。替补：梅利耶、廷贝尔、刘易斯-斯凯利、莫斯克拉、祖比门迪、梅里诺、马杜埃凯、道曼、约克雷斯。
诺丁汉森林：塞尔斯、穆里略、迪奥曼德、多明格斯、威廉姆斯、穆尼奥斯、施拉格尔、麦卡蒂、库尼亚、恩多耶、德拉普。替补：维克托、桑加雷、奥多伊、卡利穆恩多、耶茨、内茨、米伦科维奇、阿伊纳、伍德。

items.summaryEn: The best of the action as we win the north London derby
bodyEn: Our young Gunners overcame late drama to beat Tottenham Hotspur 2-1 in the U18 Premier League South.
Our north London rivals took the lead after the break through Joel Vidal-Philbert, but a quick response from Mylo Bernard saw us level a minute later.
Outfield player Emerson Nwaneri put himself forward to go in goal after both Jack Talbot and Max Lo Presti were forced off through injury.
Despite the unusual turn of events, Bernard found space in stoppage time to strike from range and score an incredible NLD winner.

bodyZh: 我们的年轻枪手克服了后期的波折，在U18英超南部联赛中以2比1击败了托特纳姆热刺。
我们的北伦敦死敌在下半场开始后由乔尔·维达尔-菲尔伯特率先破门，但米洛·伯纳德迅速做出回应，在仅仅一分钟后就为我们扳平了比分。
在杰克·塔尔博特和马克斯·洛·普雷斯蒂因伤退场后，非门将球员埃默森·恩瓦内里主动请缨担任门将。
尽管出现了这一罕见的变故，伯纳德仍在补时阶段觅得空当，远射破门，打入了一记不可思议的北伦敦德比绝杀球。

items.summaryEn: Prepare for our trip to the City Ground with team news, stats, tactics, TV coverage and more with our in-depth guide to the game
bodyEn: We go in search of our 10th win from 11 this campaign when we head to the banks of the Trent to face Nottingham Forest on Sunday (4.30pm UK).

After returning to action with successive home wins over Leeds United and Lille, we’ll head to the City Ground full of confidence having won six of our last eight Premier League away games, keeping four clean sheets.

Recent visits to the City Ground haven’t been too fruitful, with just one win in our last six visits, including successive goalless draws. But while Forest adapt to Olivier Glasner’s management, we’ll hope to pounce on their poor home form to improve that record and keep pace with the league leaders.
TRICKY START FOR GLASNER

After a turbulent 2025/26 campaign saw Nuno Espirito Santo, Ange Postecoglou, Sean Dyche and Vitor Pereira eventually accrue enough points to keep Forest up, the Portuguese coach was jettisoned in the summer, with Oliver Glasner brought in.

The £116 million sale of Elliott Anderson funded the signings of Liam Delap, Daniel Munoz and Ivorian centre-back Ousmane Diomande from Sporting Lisbon, but only one win has come from six Premier League outings, which came on the road at Aston Villa last month.

Losses to Leeds and Coventry City, plus a goalless draw against Tottenham, mean Forest have won only one of their last 14 top-flight home games and are winless in their last five. They also lost on their own turf to the Whites in the League Cup second round, while last weekend brought a miserable return to Selhurst Park for Glasner as his side squandered numerous chances before succumbing to a 3-1 defeat by Palace.
WHAT THE MANAGERS SAY

Arteta: "We have responded really well in the last two games, two very good performances and results, and now we just focus on the game against Forest, which I know is going to be a really tough one. We're going to try really hard to score goals and to prevent goals as well. It’s going to be a really tough match, they’re an extremely well-coached team.

"We already have experience with Oliver [Glasner] in the past. They’re a team that at home can create a really special momentum. In terms of the performance and what they deserve for their games, it should have been very, very different, and we are very aware of that."

Glasner: "The main topic was finishing in training. I said the one who can explain it best how to deal with this situation is Chris Wood. Overall, [he's scored] around 200 goals in English football and he had to deal with these situations. His message was: 'Always be confident, never lose trust in yourself, and there's always another one around the corner.'

"I could see players start to smile and that's how you best to deal with it. No team has seven, eight big chances like we had against Palace [against Arsenal] but it's possible to have two or three. Then, it's up us to be clinical, taking the chances and then you have the chance to win the game."
TEAM NEWS

Piero Hincapie and Martin Zubimendi both missed our midweek win against Lille after injuring ankles in training after the Leeds victory. Mikel Arteta hopes the Spaniard should be back available, while Hincapie is likely out for a few more weeks.
Christos Tzolis (muscle) and William Saliba (back) remain out longer term, while Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard, Kai Havertz and Riccardo Calafiori could return after being rested against Lille.
Glasner is sweating on the fitness of star man Morgan Gibbs-White, who has sat out the majority of training this week after picking up a minor muscular injury at Palace last weekend.

Defender Nikola Milenkovic missed that game with a foot problem but has returned to training, but Igor Jesus is out with a calf issue. Full-back Nicolo Savona has been out since January after knee surgery.
TALKING TACTICS

Adrian Clarke: The table can sometimes be misleading, and I believe that’s the case with Forest, whose performances have warranted more than their five points. In Glasner’s trademark 3-4-2-1 shape they have been very creative, manufacturing the division's second-highest number of big chances. Their big issue has been poor finishing, converting only 4.72% of their attempts into goals.The three players who make them tick attacking-wise are Gibbs-White, Dan Ndoye and James McAtee. We know all about Gibbs-White’s talent, but Swiss international Ndoye has been extremely positive of late, running at defenders and firing off shots. In central midfield, ex-Manchester City youngster McAtee has shown a lovely eye for a pass, creating 11 chances in open play.Defensively, Glasner’s men are strong. They were unusually flaky at Crystal Palace, but generally keep opponents at arm’s length, facing the joint-second-fewest shots (64), only one behind us. Centre-back Murillo is their standout defender, but the industry of new holding midfielder Xaver Schlager should not be underestimated either.Forest are not possession-heavy or especially focused on pressing, but Glasner's teams are usually superbly organised and clear in their strategies. They do attack at speed, and that is something we must be wary of, so this is going to be a stern examination.
MATCH STATS
We have won 10 of our last 15 games against Nottingham Forest in all competitions, keeping clean sheets in nine of them and in each of the last four.

Forest have only won two of their 18 Premier League games against us (11% - D5 L11), only against Newcastle (6% ) and Blackburn (10%) do they have a worse win percentage among teams they’ve faced 10+ times in the competition.
We have won 14 of our last 17 Premier League games, with nine by a one-goal margin. In the last two seasons, we have won 17 games by a single goal, the most of any side in Europe’s big-five leagues.

Oliver Glasner has just five wins in 29 games (D9 L15) since December last year. Since the start of this 29-game run, Glasner’s 17% win rate is the second-lowest among managers with 20+ games, ahead only of Rob Edwards (13%).
We have gone 1-0 down in three of our last four Premier League matches, as many as in our previous 25 games combined. No side has won more points from losing positions this season than us (6).
Forest have converted just 4.7% of their shots and have the worst xG difference in the division this season (5 goals from 10.3 xG, -5.3).

Bukayo Saka has been directly involved in five goals (3 goals, 2 assists) in six league games against Forest, his best minutes-per-goal involvement ratio against any opponent he’s faced more than twice (a goal or assist every 83 minutes).

Only Pascal Gross (18) has created more chances in the Premier League than Morgan Gibbs-White (17), who tops the charts for open-play chances created (15), big chances created (7), and expected assists (1.87).
Bruno Guimaraes has scored three goals in eight Premier League matches against Nottingham Forest; only against Brentford (4) has he netted more goals in the competition.
MATCH OFFICIALS

As he did last season, Michael Oliver will take charge of this particular fixture. We registered a win, a draw and a loss last term under his watch, with his last appointment being our 2-1 home loss against Bournemouth in April, the first time in eight matches he’d managed that we’d been defeated in.
We have won 32 of the 65 games he has refereed, stretching back 16 years. He has dished out 14 yellow cards and one red - to Phil Foden in the Manchester derby - in the top-flight this term.
Referee: Michael OliverAssistants: Stuart Burt, James MainwaringFourth official: Farai HallamVAR: Michael SalisburyAssistant VAR: Ian Hussin
RECENT TRENTSIDE TRIPS
We head to the City Ground unbeaten in the last three visits, and could register three successive clean sheets at the home of the Tricky Trees for the first time.

The last two meetings between the sides at the City Ground have ended goalless, with 40 shots attempted without success, while in January 2024 we won 2-1 with Gabriel Jesus and Bukayo Saka on target, before Taiwo Awoniyi made things nervy with a late consolation. The previous May saw us fall to a 1-0 loss when Awoniyi netted again, effectively ending our title challenge.
LIVE COVERAGE

Live commentary will be available on Arsenal.com and The Arsenal app (download now on iOS/Android) from just before kick-off, with Dan Roebuck and Adrian Clarke behind the mics to guide you through all the on-field action.
You can also find out which broadcasters are showing the action live, wherever you are in the world.

items.titleZh: 前瞻：诺丁汉森林对阵阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳即将客场挑战诺丁汉森林，查看比赛前瞻、伤情及数据。
bodyZh: 本周日（英国时间下午4:30），我们将前往特伦特河畔对阵诺丁汉森林，力争在本赛季各项赛事中取得11场中的第10场胜利。
在主场连续击败利兹联和里尔重回胜利轨道后，我们将怀揣充足的信心前往城市球场。我们在最近8个英超客场中赢下了6场，并完成了4场零封。
近期作客城市球场并不算顺利，过去6次造访仅取得1场胜利，包括连续两场互交白卷。不过，在森林适应奥利弗·格拉斯纳（Oliver Glasner）执教之际，我们希望抓住他们糟糕的主场战绩，延续这一纪录并紧咬领头羊。
格拉斯纳的艰难开局
在经历了2025/26赛季的动荡后，努诺·埃斯皮里托·桑托、安格·波斯特科格鲁、肖恩·戴奇和维托尔·佩雷拉最终积攒了足够的分数帮助森林保级，这位葡萄牙教练在夏天离任，奥利弗·格拉斯纳接任。
以1.16亿英镑出售埃利奥特·安德森的资金资助了利亚姆·德拉普、丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯以及从葡萄牙体育引进的科特迪瓦中卫乌斯马尼·迪奥曼德的加盟，但在6场英超比赛中他们仅取得一场胜利，那是上个月客场击败阿斯顿维拉的比赛。
输给利兹联和考文垂城，加上与热刺的无球言和，意味着森林在最近14个顶级联赛主场中只赢了一场，且连续5个主场不胜。他们在联赛杯第二轮的主场比赛中也输给了利兹联，而上周末格拉斯纳迎来了重返塞尔赫斯特公园的不快回忆，他的球队挥霍了多次机会后以1-3不敌水晶宫。
主帅言论
阿尔特塔：“我们在过去两场比赛中做出了非常好的回应，表现和结果都非常出色，现在我们只专注于对阵森林的比赛，我知道这将是一场非常艰难的比赛。我们会全力以赴去进球，同时做好防守。这将是一场极其艰难的比赛，他们是一支训练有素的球队。
“我们过去已经和奥利弗（格拉斯纳）有过交手经验。他们在主场能够营造出一种非常特殊的势头。就他们的表现以及他们在比赛中应得的回报而言，本该完全不同，我们对此非常清楚。”
格拉斯纳：“主要的话题是训练中的临门一脚。我说过，最能解释如何应对这种局势的人是克里斯·伍德。总的来说，他在英格兰足坛打进大约200球，他必须处理过这些情况。他的信息是：‘永远保持自信，永远不要失去对自己的信任，转角总会有下一个机会。’
“我能看到球员们开始微笑，这就是应对它的最好方法。没有哪支球队能像我们对阵水晶宫时那样创造出七、八次绝佳机会（对阵阿森纳时），但创造两三次是可能的。然后，这就取决于我们要保持高效，抓住机会，这样你就有机会赢得比赛。”
球队消息
皮耶罗·因卡皮耶和马丁·祖比门迪在击败利兹联后的训练中脚踝受伤，双双缺席了周中对阵里尔的胜利。米克尔·阿尔特塔希望这位西班牙中场能够复出，而因卡皮耶预计将缺阵数周。
克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯（肌肉）和威廉·萨利巴（背部）将长期缺阵，而布卡约·萨卡、马丁·厄德高、凯·哈弗茨和里卡多·卡拉菲奥里在轮休一场后有望复出。
格拉斯纳正在焦急等待核心球员摩根·吉布斯-怀特的伤情恢复，他在上周末对阵水晶宫时遭遇轻微肌肉受伤，本周缺席了大部分训练。
后卫尼古拉·米伦科维奇因脚部问题缺席了上一场比赛，但已恢复训练，而伊戈尔·耶稣则因小腿问题缺阵。边后卫尼科洛·萨沃纳自一月份膝盖手术以来一直缺阵。
战术探讨

阿德里安·克拉克：积分榜有时会具有欺负性，我认为森林就是如此，他们的表现本配得上多于5个积分。在格拉斯纳标志性的3-4-2-1阵型中，他们极具创造力，制造了联赛第二多的绝佳机会。他们最大的问题是临门一脚糟糕，只有4.72%的射门转化为进球。让他们的进攻运转起来的三名球员是吉布斯-怀特、丹·恩多耶和詹姆斯·麦卡蒂。我们对吉布斯-怀特的才华了如指掌，但瑞士国脚恩多耶近来表现非常积极，敢于冲击防线并起脚射门。在防守中，格拉斯纳的球队非常稳固。他们在水晶宫的表现有些反常，但总体上能将对手拒之门外，面对的射门次数并列联赛第二少（64次），仅比我们多一次。中卫穆里略是他们最出色的后卫，但新后腰扎维尔·施拉格的勤勉也不容低估。森林并不特别依赖控球或高位逼抢，但格拉斯纳的球队通常组织严密，战术清晰。他们确实会高速进攻，这是我们必须警惕的，因此这将是一场严峻的考验。
比赛数据
我们在各项赛事中对阵诺丁汉森林的最近15场比赛中赢了10场，其中9场完成零封，并且连续4场实现零封。
森林在对阵我们的18场英超比赛中只赢了2场（11%，5平11负），在交手10次以上的球队中，他们的胜率仅比对阵纽卡斯尔（6%）和布莱克本（10%）时要低。
我们在最近17场英超联赛中赢了14场，其中9场是以一球优势险胜。在过去的两个赛季里，我们有17场比赛以一球险胜，是欧洲五大联赛中所有球队最多的。
自从去年12月以来，奥利弗·格拉斯纳在29场比赛中仅取得5场胜利（9平15负）。自从这段29场比赛开始以来，格拉斯纳17%的胜率在执教20场以上的教练中倒数第二，仅领先于罗布·爱德华兹（13%）。
我们在最近4场英超比赛中有3场比分0-1落后，这与我们此前25场比赛的总和相当。本赛季没有哪支球队在落后情况下获得的分数比我们更多（6分）。
森林本赛季仅将4.7%的射门转化为进球，并且拥有本赛季联赛中最差的预期进球差（10.3个预期进球打入5球，-5.3）。
布卡约·萨卡在对阵森林的6场联赛中直接参与了5粒进球（3球2助攻），这是他在面对交手超过两次的任何对手时，每分钟进球参与率最高的一项纪录（平均每83分钟贡献一球或助攻）。
只有帕斯卡尔·格罗斯（18次）在英超联赛中创造的机会比摩根·吉布斯-怀特（17次）更多，后者在运动战创造机会（15次）、绝佳机会创造（7次）以及预期助攻（1.87）方面均高居榜首。
布鲁诺·吉马良斯在对阵诺丁汉森林的8场英超比赛中打进3球；他在该赛事中进球更多的对手只有布伦特福德（4球）。
比赛裁判
与上赛季一样，迈克尔·奥利弗将执法本场比赛。在他的执法下，我们上赛季取得了1胜1平1负的战绩，他上一次执法我们的比赛是4月主场1-2不敌伯恩茅斯，那也是在我们经历的连续8场由他执法的比赛中我们首次遭遇失利。
在追溯到16年前他主吹的65场比赛中，我们赢下了32场。本赛季他在顶级联赛中已经出示了14张黄牌和1张红牌——在曼市德比中罚下了菲尔·福登。
裁判：迈克尔·奥利弗 助理裁判：斯图尔特·伯特、詹姆斯·曼宁林 第四官员：法莱·哈拉姆 视频助理裁判（VAR）：迈克尔·索尔斯伯里 助理视频助理裁判：伊恩·赫辛
近期城市球场之行
我们最近三次造访城市球场保持不败，并有望首次在该球场连续三场实现零封。
双方在城市球场的最近两次交锋均以互交白卷收场，40次射门无果；而在2024年1月，我们凭借热苏斯和萨卡的进球2-1取胜，随后塔伊沃·阿沃尼伊在尾声阶段扳回一城制造了悬念。前年五月，我们以0-1落败，阿沃尼伊再度破门，这实际上终结了我们的争冠希望。
现场直播
比赛开球前不久，您可以通过Arsenal.com和阿森纳官方App（现已在iOS/Android平台上线）收听现场解说，丹·罗巴克和阿德里安·克拉克将为您带来精彩的赛事评述。
您还可以查询全球各地的转播机构，了解在哪里可以观看本场比赛的现场直播。

items.titleEn: Smith scores but frustrated with Birmingham draw
items.summaryEn: Goalscorer Olivia Smith felt we lacked urgency in the first half of our 1-1 draw with the Blues
bodyEn: Olivia Smith was frustrated to see us drop points at Emirates Stadium as we were held to a 1-1 draw by Birmingham City.
Oceane Hurtre gave the Blues the lead on the counter-attack, before a rocket from Olivia drew us level, but we were unable to convert our dominance into a second goal.

"Its quite frustrating not to get the result," Olivia said after the game, "I think we just need more urgency within the first half, to bring it like we did in the second half and again, put the ball in the back of the net and get our goal.
"Glad to take away a point, but again, it just needs to be better. [We need] to keep improving and keep fighting and staying together."
We'll be back in action next Saturday with a north London derby away at Tottenham next weekend, where Olivia and the rest of our squad will be looking to get back to winning ways.
"The most important thing is for us to stay together, build confidence within training, repetition in front of goal, because we need goals at the minute."
While the result didn't go our way in N5, our supporters were right behind us once again, which Olivia feels will be crucial to turning results around.
"They always bring out great support, [we're] so happy to have them here.
"Again, disappointed not to get the result, must be frustrating for them, but they stay with us and support us."

items.titleZh: 史密斯进球但对战平伯明翰感到遗憾
items.summaryZh: 进球功臣奥利维亚·史密斯表示球队在1-1战平伯明翰的上半场缺乏紧迫感。
bodyZh: 在酋长球场以1-1被伯明翰城逼平后，奥利维亚·史密斯对球队丢掉积分感到遗憾。
奥谢娜·许尔特通过反击帮助伯明翰城取得领先，随后奥利维亚轰出一记世界波扳平比分，但我们未能将场上优势转化为第二粒进球。
“没能拿到理想的结果令人相当沮丧，”奥利维亚赛后表示，“我认为我们在上半场需要更多紧迫感，要像下半场那样展现出状态，再次把球送入网窝并取得进球。”
“很高兴能拿到一分，但话说回来，表现还需要更好。（我们需要）继续进步、继续战斗并团结一致。”
我们将在下周六迎来客场对阵热刺的北伦敦德比，届时奥利维亚和全队将力求重回胜利轨道。
“最重要的是我们保持团结，在训练中建立信心，在门前进行重复训练，因为我们目前需要进球。”
尽管结果不如人意，但球迷们再次坚定地支持着我们，奥利维亚认为这对于扭转局面至关重要。
“他们总是给予我们巨大的支持，我们很高兴有他们在场。”
“再次对没能取得结果感到失望，这对他们来说一定也很沮丧，但他们依然陪伴并支持着我们。”

items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners complete a dramatic north London derby comeback
bodyEn: Our young Gunners completed a dramatic north London derby comeback to beat Tottenham Hotspur 2-1 in the U18 Premier League South.
A goalless opening 45 was dwarfed by two quick goals after the interval, with Joel Vidal-Philbert scoring before Mylo Bernard found the perfect rebuttal a minute later.
Despite no recognised goalkeeper on the field late on, Bernard defied the odds in stoppage time, smashing home his second to seal a thrilling victory over our rivals.
FIRST HALF
It was an end-to-end start, with Oliver Boast first clipping the bar for Spurs before our own attack saw Maalik Hashi’s shot rebound to Bernard, whose effort was tipped over the upright.
Jaden Maghoma came close to breaking the deadlock before half-time, receiving a squared pass from Hakeem Abubakar, but his shot whisked past the post.
SECOND HALF

Tottenham took the lead shortly after the restart, as Cayon Hanson marauded through our midfield and played it out wide to Vidal-Philbert, whose shot caught Jack Talbot off guard, leaving our goalkeeper unable to get a strong hand to it.

We responded straight from the kick-off, as Abubakar's run down the left flank led to a cross into the box, where Bernard got in front of his defender to guide the ball into the back of the net for 1-1.

An eventful spell for Talbot saw our no. 1 make a superb fingertip save to deny Armend Muslika's free-kick from 20 yards, before being forced off after colliding with Boast and replaced by Max Lo Presti.

Our substitute goalkeeper was then caught up in a clatter himself, as he attempted to collect a cross but was caught in the air by Phoenix Offiah and had to be taken off, leaving us without a natural stopper between the sticks.
The void in goal was filled by Emerson Nwaneri, who did brilliantly to withstand Tottenham's attacks as time ticked beyond the 90.
There was still time for late NLD drama and, with seconds on the clock, Nwaneri sent a long free-kick to Luis Munoz and onto Bernard out wide.
Our striker cut inside and hit from distance, smashing the ball in off the bar and beyond Mikel Jack to complete an incredible turnaround and snatch derby-day delight at the death.
WHAT IT MEANS
We extend our winning run to five across all competitions and inflict Tottenham's first defeat of the campaign, narrowing the gap to just three points.
Continuing to climb the table, we now sit fourth in the U18 Premier League South on 13 points.
WHAT'S NEXT
Many of our young Gunners will feature in midweek UEFA Youth League action, against Bayern Munich on Wednesday, October 21.
Kick-off at the Stadion im FC Bayern Campus is scheduled for 3pm (UK time).
LINE-UPS
Arsenal XI: Talbot (Lo Presti 75, Sesay 89), Abubakar, Mbala, McCarron (Pedro 79), Owusu-Gyasi, Purdy (Odaji-Ukueku 61), Murisa, Nwaneri, Hashi (Donczew 61), Bernard, Maghoma (Munoz 45).
Subs: Stachow.
Tottenham Hotspur XI: Jack, Sandiford, Jobling, Hanson, Tingey (Evans 63), Senyah, Coffi-Smith (Beckles 70), Glancy (Offiah 59), Boast, Muslika (Salter 87), Vidal-Philbert (Olajide 82).
Subs: Cherifi, Agyekum.

items.titleZh: U18青年队战报：阿森纳 2-1 托特纳姆热刺
items.summaryZh: 青年枪手上演戏剧性逆转，在北伦敦德比中击败热刺。
bodyZh: 我们的青年枪手在U18英超南部联赛中上演了戏剧性的北伦敦德比逆转，以2-1击败托特纳姆热刺。
上半场双方互交白卷，下半场伊始风云突变，乔尔·维达尔-菲尔伯特（Joel Vidal-Philbert）先下一城，而迈洛·伯纳德（Mylo Bernard）在短短一分钟后便作出完美回应。
尽管比赛尾声时场上没有正牌门将，伯纳德仍在补时阶段力挽狂澜，轰入个人第二球，锁定了一场击败死敌的惊天胜利。
上半场
比赛开局节奏极快，热刺的奥利弗·波斯特（Oliver Boast）率先击中横梁，随后我们的进攻中马利克·哈希（Maalik Hashi）的射门被扑出，伯纳德的补射也被托出横梁。
半场结束前贾登·马古马（Jaden Maghoma）险些打破僵局，他接到哈基姆·阿布巴卡尔（Hakeem Abubakar）的横传，但射门擦柱而出。
下半场
易边再战不久热刺便取得领先，凯永·汉森（Cayon Hanson）长驱直入穿透我们的中场并分球到边路，维达尔-菲尔伯特起脚射门令杰克·塔尔博特（Jack Talbot）措手不及，我们的门将未能将球挡出。
我们开球后立即作出回应，阿布巴卡尔左路突破传中，伯纳德抢在防守球员身前将球推入网窝，比分变为1-1。
我们的1号门将塔尔博特经历了一段波折，他先是神勇指尖扑出了阿尔门德·穆斯利卡（Armend Muslika）20码外的任意球，随后因与波斯特相撞受伤离场，被马克斯·洛·普雷斯蒂（Max Lo Presti）替换下场。
我们的替补门将在出击接高空球时与菲尼克斯·奥菲亚（Phoenix Offiah）相撞也受伤离场，这导致我们门前没有了正牌门将。
空缺的门将位置由埃默森·恩瓦内里（Emerson Nwaneri）顶替，他在90分钟后的比赛中表现出色，抵挡住了热刺的进攻。
比赛依然留有德比战的压轴戏，在比赛所剩无几的时刻，恩瓦内里开出长传找到路易斯·穆诺兹（Luis Munoz），再由其分给边路的伯纳德。
我们的前锋内切后远射，皮球击中横梁弹入球门，击败了米克尔·杰克（Mikel Jack），完成了不可思议的逆转，在绝杀中收获了德比日的喜悦。
这意味着什么
我们各项赛事取得五连胜，并送给热刺本赛季的首场失利，将积分差距缩小至三分。
我们继续在积分榜上攀升，目前以13分排名U18英超南部联赛第四位。
接下来
我们的许多青年枪手将参加周中的欧洲青年联赛，于10月21日星期三对阵拜仁慕尼黑。
拜仁慕尼黑校园球场（Stadion im FC Bayern Campus）的开球时间定于下午3点（英国时间）。

items.titleEn: Team news: Four changes to face Birmingham City
items.summaryEn: Renee Slegers has made four changes to the side that faced Manchester City before the international break
bodyEn: Renee Slegers has made four changes to the starting XI as we return from the October international break against Birmingham City at Emirates Stadium.
We take on the Blues looking for our first win in N5 this season, and our first in domestic action since the opening round of the Women's Super League season.

Misa Rodriguez is back in goal, replacing Anneke Borbe, while Smilla Holmberg comes into defence in place of Emily Fox. The rest of our back four remains the same as it was at Etihad Stadium before the break, with Ona Batlle at left-back and Leah Williamson partnering Lotte Wubben-Moy in central defence.

The other two changes come in attack, with Stina Blackstenius and Olivia Smith coming in for Kim Little, who misses out through illness, and Mariona Caldentey, who will be sidelined for several weeks with a hamstring injury.
With Mariona and Little out, Alessia Russo joins Kyra Cooney-Cross and Georgia Stanway in midfield, while Lisa Baum keeps her place on the wing.
Frida Maanum misses out on the matchday squad with a muscle injury, while Selina Cerci is absent after underdoing knee surgery during the international break.

bodyZh: 随着我们在十月国际比赛日后重返酋长球场对阵伯明翰城，雷妮·斯勒格斯对首发阵容进行了四处调整。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has defended Arsenal’s decision to cut up to 60 jobs and insisted it was felt to be necessary to ensure they can continue achieving success.

The Premier League champions are understood to have informed the staff whose positions are at risk after a consultation process started by Boston Consulting Group (BCG) before the end of last season. Arsenal hope the number of redundancies can be reduced and will attempt to redeploy affected employees wherever possible, although some job losses may be unavoidable.

It is understood the catering and travel departments are among the affected, and that the men’s and women’s first-team performance and coaching staff will not be impacted. The academy, Arsenal Women, Arsenal in the Community, the Arsenal Foundation and site security teams are also exempt, although other areas of the wider football operation are included in the review, which was overseen internally by the managing director, Richard Garlick.

The timing of the proposed cuts has attracted scrutiny after last week’s announcement of Arteta’s new contract, worth more than £20m a season. Arsenal say the restructuring process began before the deal was announced and the manager said he was not the appropriate person to answer questions about the redundancies.

“It was explained to me about the exercise, and the analysis that has been done across the club, and with the intention always to evolve to improve,” he said. “Some decisions have to be taken, to put people in the right roles, and keep investing to achieve what we want to achieve and the success that we want to create. So that has been explained. Obviously I am not the right person to answer that question. That’s for sure. And hopefully everybody will respect that.”

The club refused to allow Arteta to answer any more questions on the subject. Arsenal’s most recent financial accounts, for the 2024-25 campaign, show that operating costs rose from £148m the previous year to £201m, with the owner, Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, keen to cut costs despite winning the Premier League title in May.

Arteta was instrumental in reshaping Arsenal’s medical department over the summer, when the former Aston Villa team doctor Arnaldo Abrantes arrived, and is believed to have bolstered his backroom staff in other areas.

Arsenal travel to Nottingham Forest on Sunday – the first of four away games in their next five matches – and Kai Havertz is again expected to start ahead of Viktor Gyökeres. The Sweden striker has yet to find the net for Arsenal this season and struggled against Lille in midweek after scoring four goals on international duty.

items.titleZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔为阿森纳裁员辩护，以帮助俱乐部“发展并创造成功”
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔为阿森纳裁员决定辩护，称此举旨在确保球队持续取得成功。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔为阿森纳裁员多达60人的决定进行了辩护，并坚称这是确保俱乐部能够继续取得成功所必需的举措。
据了解，在波士顿咨询集团（BCG）在上赛季结束前开始咨询流程后，英超冠军已将职位面临风险的员工进行了通知。阿森纳希望能够减少裁员人数，并将在可能的情况下尽量重新安置受影响的员工，尽管某些裁员可能是不可避免的。
据了解，餐饮和旅游部门属于受影响的部门之一，而男子和女子一线队的表现与教练团队将不受影响。青训营、阿森纳女足、社区阿森纳、阿森纳基金会以及场地安保团队也将豁免，不过其他广泛的足球运营领域被包含在审查之内，该审查由董事总经理理查德·加利克在内部监督。
在上周宣布阿尔特塔签下每赛季价值超过2000万英镑的新合同后，拟议裁员的时间安排引起了人们的审视。阿森纳表示，重组流程在合同宣布之前就已经开始，而主教练表示他不是回答有关裁员问题的合适人选。
他表示：“俱乐部向我解释了这项工作，以及在整个俱乐部范围内进行的分析，其意图始终是为了进化和改进。必须做出一些决定，把合适的人放到合适的岗位上，并继续投资以实现我们的目标以及我们想要创造的成功。这就是解释。显然我不是回答这个问题的合适人选。这是肯定的。希望大家都能尊重这一点。”
俱乐部拒绝让阿尔特塔就此话题回答更多问题。阿森纳2024-25赛季的最新财务报告显示，运营成本从上一年的1.48亿英镑上升至2.01亿英镑，尽管在5月份赢得了英超冠军，但老板克伦克体育娱乐公司仍希望削减成本。
阿尔特塔在夏天重塑阿森纳医疗部门的过程中发挥了关键作用，当时前阿斯顿维拉队医阿纳尔多·阿布兰特斯加盟，外界认为他在其他领域也加强了自己的教练组。
阿森纳将于周日客场对阵诺丁汉森林，这是他们接下来五场比赛中的四个客场之旅的第一场，预计哈弗茨将再次首发出场，领先于维克托·哲凯赖什。这位瑞典前锋本赛季尚未为阿森纳进球，在国家队比赛日攻入四球后，周中对阵里尔时表现挣扎。

bodyEn: A lively reception awaits the former Liverpool midfielders Jordan Henderson and Xabi Alonso at Everton and, in the case of the former, any jeers can be considered an unintentional tribute. They will speak of what the 36-year-old is able to produce now as much as what, and where, he delivered in the past. With two goals and an assist against Bournemouth last Saturday, Henderson became the oldest player to contribute directly to three goals in a Premier League game, and demonstrated his role at Chelsea is not simply to elevate standards off the pitch. His midfield partnership with Moisés Caicedo gave Alonso’s team balance and enabled the front three of Morgan Rogers, João Pedro and Cole Palmer to flourish. Their confrontation against an Everton defence that had impressed this season, only to litter the draw at Hull with costly mistakes, will provide a stern test of the hosts’ unbeaten start and may well be dictated by the veteran behind them. Andy Hunter
Everton v Chelsea, Saturday 12.30pm (all times BST)

Still unbeaten in the top flight, Brentford are being served well by their commitment to pragmatism. Keith Andrews’ side like to sit deep, close off the middle of the pitch and force opponents to play around them, while flooding the opposition box at set pieces and throw-ins allows them to create the chances from which most of their goals arrive. In spanking six past Lask, the Austrian champions, Liverpool showed how good they can be on the front foot, but they will face far less obliging hosts at the Gtech Community Stadium. If Andoni Iraola’s side can dominate the ball and move it quickly enough to penetrate Brentford’s rearguard, they could win comfortably. However, the Bees’ efforts to turn the afternoon into a saloon brawl and capitalise on dead-ball situations may help to maintain their unbeaten run. Barry Glendenning
Brentford v Liverpool, Saturday 3pm

Gonzalo García has one league goal from 18 shots this season. The striker joined Fulham from Real Madrid in the summer and has looked promising in patches. García is 22 and capable of getting on the end of chances. He has an expected goals tally of 3.60 but is underperforming with his finishing. The challenge is to become more clinical. Fulham, bottom of the league, have six goals in six games and García is without a goal since scoring on his debut, against Chelsea. Álvaro Arbeloa has put a lot of faith in his fellow Spaniard. The head coach is under increasing pressure and winless Fulham need García to fire when they host Hull. Jacob Steinberg
Fulham v Hull, Saturday 3pm

Even when losing for the first time this season in Wednesday’s 4-2 Champions League defeat by Paris Saint-Germain, Manchester City appeared the real deal as they rallied from 3-0 down after 32 minutes to give the European champions a scare. Enzo Maresca deserves credit for following Pep Guardiola serenely; his City, so far, are a free-flowing attacking machine and invigorating to watch. If not for the guilty verdict against the club for serious financial breaches of Premier League rules, the perma-twinkling Italian might be more widely lauded. Ipswich last won at City in the competition in November 2000: do not expect the statistic to change on Saturday. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

Newcastle’s latest attempt to play vertical football left Matthias Jaissle’s side horizontal at Coventry on Monday night. That 4-1 defeat has prompted quite an inquest on Tyneside, where Jaissle could do without his players falling flat on their faces once more when Aston Villa visit St James’ Park. Jaissle maintains that his vertical football is the brand of high-octane, aggressive attacking that Newcastle’s hierarchy believes should become the club’s default, and is the way fans want to see the team play. That argument is not without validity but it is also worth remembering that, less than a decade ago, under Rafael Benítez’s charge, Newcastle often played a low block bolstered by three at the back, rarely took unnecessary risks and improved steadily. Admittedly resources were thinner then but the fans almost universally adored Benítez and were heartbroken when he eventually tired of Mike Ashley’s ownership and resigned. Quite apart from making his dislike for chaotic football plain, the Spaniard was a realist who knew a gung-ho approach would spell relegation. Granted, tactical fashions have changed, but Jaissle could do worse than slow things down a bit and search for his inner Rafa against Villa. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Aston Villa, Saturday 5.30pm

With nine games each scheduled for the month between international breaks, Bournemouth v Sunderland will give an early indication of how both will cope during their first experience of such a relentless Thursday-Sunday autumnal grind. Sunderland are 17th, Bournemouth are 18th, and with seven points between them after six Premier League rounds, scaling similarly dizzy heights to last season already seems a lofty goal. For both clubs, European campaigns are far too much of an exciting novelty to be considered anything like a chore. In circumstances where squad depth is crucial, the returns of Justin Kluivert for the hosts and Brian Brobbey for the visitors will be welcomed by Marco Rose and Régis Le Bris. It would be no great surprise to see either Dutch international make a game-deciding contribution in what is already a six-pointer on the south coast. BG

Bournemouth v Sunderland, Sunday 2pm

Brighton’s momentum appears unstoppable at the moment, although supporters will be wary of Sunday’s showdown against Crystal Palace given their recent history. They haven’t beaten Palace since a 4-1 thrashing at the Amex in February 2024, when Roberto De Zerbi was in charge, while Fabian Hürzeler managed only a point in four encounters with the Eagles under Oliver Glasner. Both are having to juggle European commitments this season and Brighton will start as heavy favourites against Pierre Sage’s side after their superb start to the campaign. Palace have big concerns in defence, but can the Frenchman defy the odds against the Premier League’s top scorers? Ed Aarons
Brighton v Crystal Palace, Sunday 2pm

Michael Carrick has lost five of his past six technical-area duels with Daniel Farke. Indeed the only time Manchester United’s manager has bested his Leeds counterpart was in a League Cup tie during his Middlesbrough tenure. If such statistics are not sufficient to put Manchester United’s currently beleaguered manager off a trip to West Yorkshire on Sunday, there is a sense that Leeds are overdue a first victory at Elland Road since 2002 against their arch-enemies from across the Pennines. One thing is certain; it will be a typically raucous latter-day War of the Roses. But, right now, while the White Rose blooms, its red counterpart is wilting alarmingly. Will Carrick survive this latest meeting with a manager who, at Championship level during his Middlesbrough days, proved something of a nemesis? He will not care to remember that last January a 1-1 draw at Elland Road proved to be Ruben Amorim’s final game in charge of Manchester United. LT
Leeds v Manchester United, Sunday 2pm

Despite losing 3-1 to Crystal Palace last weekend, Nottingham Forest played some excellent front-foot football only to be let down by extreme profligacy in front of goal and vulnerability to their hosts’ counterattacks. Oliver Glasner attributed his side’s defeat to karma upon his return to Palace, saying: “It was like I didn’t deserve to win at Selhurst Park, because the players did everything.” When they welcome Arsenal to the City Ground on Sunday they will give the champions plenty to ponder if they can play as well again. Mikel Arteta’s side were unconvincing for 65 minutes against Leeds last weekend and failed to impress until they brought on their heavy artillery about the same time against Lille on Tuesday. If one or both of Morgan Gibbs-White and Liam Delap can convert the kind of chances they missed at Selhurst Park, Forest have every chance of getting something. BG
Nottingham Forest v Arsenal, Sunday 4.30pm

The last time Tottenham hosted Coventry in the Premier League, Steffen Iversen, Les Ferdinand and Serhiy Rebrov scored in a comfortable 3-0 win. And while Spurs fans will almost certainly have envisaged a similar scoreline when the fixtures were announced, they will now be viewing Monday night’s fixture with even more than the usual amount of apprehension and dread. Like Tottenham, Coventry’s main problem until recently was an inability to convert chances, but in their demolition of Newcastle on Monday they visibly grew in confidence and swagger as four different players took the plaudits. While it’s taken a while and they may still struggle, through back-to-back wins Frank Lampard’s side have now announced themselves as a Premier League force to be reckoned with, which is something Tottenham haven’t managed in more than two years. BG
Tottenham v Coventry, Monday 8pm

items.titleZh: 英超周末看点：阿森纳客场对阵诺丁汉森林
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳周末将客场挑战诺丁汉森林，本轮英超迎来多场焦点对决。
bodyZh: 前利物浦中场球员乔丹·亨德森和哈维·阿隆索将在埃弗顿迎来热烈的欢迎，对于前者而言，任何嘘声都可以被视为一种无意的致敬。人们将谈论这位36岁的球员现在能够贡献什么，就像过去他在哪里以及贡献了什么一样。上周六对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中，亨德森贡献了两射一传，成为英超历史上单场直接参与三球年龄最大的球员，这也证明了他在切尔西的作用不仅仅是提升场外标准。他和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多的中场搭档为阿隆索的球队带来了平衡，并让摩根·罗杰斯、若昂·佩德罗和科尔·帕尔默组成的前场三叉戟得以大显身手。他们与埃弗顿防线的对决将是对主队不败金身的严峻考验。
埃弗顿对阵切尔西，周六中午12:30（英国夏令时，下同）

布伦特福德在顶级联赛中依然保持不败，其实用主义的战术风格为他们带来了丰厚回报。基斯·安德鲁斯的球队喜欢沉退防守，封锁中路并迫使对手从外围进攻，同时在定位球和界外球时大举压入对方禁区，这让他们创造了大部分进球的机会。在以6比0大胜奥地利冠军LASK时，利物浦展现了他们积极进攻时的出色状态，但他们在格技社区球场将面对防守更为顽强的主队。如果对手能够控球并以足够快的速度撕破布伦特福德的防线，他们或许能轻松取胜。然而，主队试图将比赛变成一场混战并利用死球局面的努力，或许能帮助他们延续不败纪录。
布伦特福德对阵利物浦，周六下午3点

贡萨洛·加西亚本赛季在联赛中18次射门只打进1球。这位前锋在夏天从皇家马德里加盟富勒姆，在比赛的某些时段表现出了潜力。加西亚现年22岁，具备捕捉机会的能力。他的预期进球数达到了3.60，但他的终结效率不佳。摆在他面前的挑战是提高门前把握机会的能力。目前排名联赛垫底的富勒姆在6场比赛中攻入6球，加西亚自从在对阵切尔西的处子秀中破门以来就一直未能进球。阿尔瓦罗·阿尔韦拉罗对这位同胞给予了极大的信任。这位主教练正面临越来越大的压力，未尝胜绩的富勒姆在主场迎战赫尔城时亟需加西亚挺身而出。
富勒姆对阵赫尔城，周六下午3点

即使在周三以2比4输给巴黎圣日耳曼遭遇本赛季首场失利时，曼城在开场32分钟内从0比3落后奋起直追，给欧冠冠军制造了不小的麻烦，依然展现出了真正的实力。恩佐·马雷斯卡平静地追随瓜佩普·瓜迪奥拉的表现理应受到赞赏；到目前为止，他的曼城是一台流畅的进攻机器，令人赏心悦目。如果不是因为该俱乐部因严重违反英超财务规则而被判有罪，这位闪耀的意大利人可能会受到更广泛的赞誉。伊普斯维奇上一次在该赛事中客胜曼城还要追溯到2000年11月：不要指望周六这一统计数据会发生改变。
曼城对阵伊普斯维奇，周六下午3点

纽卡斯尔联队尝试纵向足球的最新尝试，导致马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒的球队周一晚上在考文垂被打得横着离开。那场1比4的失利在泰恩赛德引发了一场大清查，贾伊斯勒最不希望看到的就是当阿斯顿维拉造访圣詹姆斯公园时，他的球员再次一败涂地。贾伊斯勒坚信，他的纵向足球正是纽卡斯尔高层认为应该成为俱乐部默认风格、且球迷们希望看到的充满激情、极具侵略性的进攻品牌。这一论点并非没有道理，但也值得记住的是，不到十年前在拉法·贝尼特斯的带领下，纽卡斯尔经常采用三中卫的低位防守，极少冒不必要的风险并稳步提升。不可否认当时资源较为单薄，但球迷几乎普遍喜爱贝尼特斯，并在他最终厌倦迈克·阿什利的所有权而辞职时心碎。撇开他对混乱足球的不满不谈，这位西班牙人是一个现实主义者，深知大举压上的战术会导致降级。当然，战术风向已经改变，但贾伊斯勒与其盲目激进，倒不如在对阵维拉时放慢节奏，寻找内心的拉法。
纽卡斯尔对阵阿斯顿维拉，周六下午5点30分

由于国际比赛日之间的一个月内各自有九场比赛要踢，伯恩茅斯对阵桑德兰的比赛将为双方如何应对首次经历这种无情的周四-周日秋季魔鬼赛程提供早期迹象。桑德兰排名第17位，伯恩茅斯排名第18位，在经过六轮英超联赛后，两队积分相差7分，想要达到上赛季那样令人眩晕的高度似乎已经是一个高不可攀的目标。对于这两家俱乐部而言，欧战征程远非一件令人兴奋的新鲜事，更谈不上是什么苦差事。在阵容深度至关重要的情况下，主队的贾斯廷·克鲁伊维特和客队的布赖恩·布罗贝的回归将受到马尔科·罗斯和雷吉斯·勒布里的欢迎。在这场南海岸的价值六分的关键战中，看到任何一位荷兰国脚做出决定比赛的贡献都不会令人感到意外。
订阅每日足球
通过卫报对世界足球的视角开启您的夜晚
在时事通讯推广之后
伯恩茅斯对阵桑德兰，周日下午2点

布莱顿目前的势头似乎势不可挡，但考虑到最近的历史，球迷们会对周日对阵水晶宫的对决保持警惕。自从罗伯托·德泽尔比执教期间在2024年2月的运河球场以4比1大胜以来，他们就没有赢过水晶宫，而法比安·许策勒在奥利弗·格拉斯纳手下四次对阵老鹰队也只拿到了一场平局。本赛季两支球队都必须兼顾欧战任务，凭借出色的开局，布莱顿在迎战皮埃尔·萨奇的球队时将占据绝对优势。水晶宫的防线存在巨大隐患，但这位法国主帅能否在英超顶级火力面前创造奇迹？
布莱顿对阵水晶宫，周日下午2点

迈克尔·卡里克在教练席上最近六次与丹尼尔·法尔克的较量中输掉了五场。事实上，这位曼联主教练唯一一次击败他的老对手还是在米德尔斯堡执教期间的一场联赛杯比赛中。如果这些数据还不足以打消曼联目前这位饱受困扰的主教练在周日前往西约克郡的念头的话，人们有一种感觉，利兹联对阵自2002年以来首次在埃兰路球场战胜他们来自奔宁山脉另一侧的老死对头已经逾期太久。有一点是确定的；这将是一场具有现代典型喧嚣色彩的玫瑰战争。但目前，当白玫瑰盛开时，红玫瑰却在惊人地枯萎。卡里克能否在这场与一位在米德尔斯堡时期曾堪称其苦主的教练的再度交锋中生还？他一定不愿想起去年1月在埃兰路球场的那场1比1平局，正是鲁本·阿莫林执教曼联的最后一场比赛。
利兹联对阵曼联，周日下午2点

尽管上周末1比3不敌水晶宫，但诺丁汉森林踢出了一些非常出色的前场进攻，只是在门前极度挥霍机会以及防范对手反击时的脆弱让他们付出了代价。奥利弗·格拉斯纳在重返塞尔赫斯特公园球场时将球队的失利归咎于因果报应，他说道：“感觉我不配在塞尔赫斯特公园赢球，因为球员们付出了一切。”当他们在周日迎来阿森纳的造访时，如果他们能再次踢出如此出色的表现，将给卫冕冠军带来足够多的思考。米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在上周末对阵利兹联时表现得缺乏说服力，直到周二差不多同一时间换上重兵后才在对阵里尔时让人眼前一亮。如果摩根·吉布斯-怀特和利亚姆·德拉普两人中有一人或全部人能够将他们在塞尔赫斯特公园错失的机会转化为进球，森林队完全有机会取得积分。
诺丁汉森林对阵阿森纳，周日下午4点30分

托特纳姆热刺上一次在英超主场迎战考文垂时，斯特芬·埃弗森、莱斯·费迪南德和谢尔盖·雷布罗夫各进一球，取得了一场3比0的轻松胜利。虽然当赛程公布时，热刺球迷几乎肯定会设想过类似的比分，但他们现在带着比以往更多的忧虑和恐惧来看待周一晚上的这场比赛。和热刺一样，考文垂直到最近的主要问题也是无法将机会转化为进球，但在周一击败纽卡斯尔的比赛中，随着四名不同的球员建功，他们的信心和气势明显增强。虽然这花了一些时间，他们可能仍在挣扎，但通过连胜，弗兰克·兰帕德的球队现在已经宣告自己是一支不容小觑的英超力量，这是热刺在两年多时间里都未能做到的事情。
托特纳姆热刺对阵考文垂，周一晚上8点

items.titleEn: Arsenal 3-0 Lille: Champions League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Arsenal toiled for an hour before tearing Lille apart three times in eight second-half minutes 1 min: Peeeeeep!Right then. Hands shaken, coin tossed, pennants exchanged, huddles broken. It’s time. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Right, that’s all from me. Bye! Before I go, here’s Ed Aarons’ match report again:
And by way of parting gift here’s Sid Lowe on Manchester United’s defeat at Atletico Madrid:
Eberiche Eze sums the match up:

double quotation markGood performance. We done what we needed to do, played free and enjoyed it, which is the main thing. A lot of teams come here with a lot of energy so the first half can be quite difficult, but the aim is to grind teams down.
Ed Aarons’ match report has landed!

Twelve wins in a row and counting. On a night when Arsenal remembered Ken Friar – the club’s life president who was instrumental in their move from Highbury to the Emirates in 2006 – it was fitting that Mikel ­Arteta’s side should rack up yet another Champions League milestone at their home that has become a fortress.

Such has Arsenal’s dominance been here in recent seasons that when Bukayo Saka slotted home their third against a dogged Lille side, it was the 36th goal they have scored at the Emirates in the league or group stage since returning to Europe’s top table under Arteta three years ago.
Much more here:
While we wait for our match report, here’s one on England’s 5-0 trouncing of Greece in their women’s World Cup play-off:
Tonight’s Champions League scores in full:

Arsenal 3-0 Lille Atletico Madrid 2-0 Manchester United Galatasaray 1-4 Barcelona Internazionale 3-4 Club Brugge Lens 0-2 Sporting RB Leipzig 1-0 PSV Sabah 2-0 Slavia Prague Viking 3-3 Bayern Munich* Villarreal 3-1 Napoli
* Drama here: Viking 2-0 up at half-time, 2-3 down when Michael Olise was sent off for a second yellow card in the 73rd minute, and they snatched a last-minute equaliser.
Jurrien Timber, whose goal cracked Lille open, has a chat:

double quotation markI had some moments in the first half. The first touch was good, which was half of the job. Then Noni was screaming “Shoot! Shoot! Shoot!”, so I shot. I wasn’t thinking too much. I was just thinking, “I need to shoot”. We needed that first goal. We were playing well but we needed that goal. We know how good we are. First half we had some moments, we were sloppy, but we were always in control. We just need to keep going. It’s still early in the season.

90+4 mins: It’s all over! Three goals in eight minutes carry Arsenal to victory over an impressively organised but ultimately outclassed Lille, who simply couldn’t give the ball away as frequently as they did in the second half and get away with it.
90+2 mins: Havertz closes down the keeper a little overenthusiastically, catches him as he follows through having made his clearance, and is booked.
90+1 mins: Into stoppage time, of which there’ll be three minutes or so.
90 mins: A lovely first-time pass from Odegaard to Dowman, inside a congested penalty area. Doesn’t come to anything, but absolutely great all the same.
88 mins: Manchester United, meanwhile, are two goals and a man down in Madrid.
85 mins: Arsenal bring Max Dowman on for Eze.
84 mins: Arsenal playing at walking pace, which they were pretty much doing for much of the first hour but which feels much less aggravating now.
82 mins: Lille bring Soriba Diaoune on for Bakwa.
81 mins: Goffi gets booked for fouling Eze, not a good challenge at all, but not quite bad enough for anything more severe.
78 mins: Olivier Giroud gets the fourth-loudest cheer of the night so far as he comes on for Ueda. Calvin Verdonk also comes on, for Perraud, and Arsenal bring Ben White on for Timber.

77 mins: Lille give the ball away again, about 40 yards from their goal, and Arsenal have four against two and really should score. But Guimaraes has no interest in passing it, and instead takes a shot from 25 yards that Ozer saves.
77 mins: Olivier Giroud is, apparently, about to get his moment.
76 mins: Not having Gyokeres on the pitch makes such a big difference for Arsenal.
73 mins: Almost a chance for Lille! Rice thinks he’s been fouled but the referee waves play on, the ball is played infield from the right to Bakwa, and Konsa throws himself in the way of his shot.
73 mins: Lille take off Bentaleb and Mukau, and bring on Sahraoui and Kjaergaard.

I’m old enough to remember when this game felt close. The three substitutes combine for this one: Odegaard releases Havertz down the right side of the penalty area, he cuts back to Saka, and Saka sidefoots across goal and in at the far post!
70 mins: Save! Arsenal are now all but unstoppable. Saka’s cross from the right almost falls to Rice, and a few seconds later Eze is played in to the left of goal, but Ozer gets a hand to his shot.

Arsenal double their lead, and this goal is all the sweeter for coming from the ball being gifted to them by the former Spurs midfielder Nabil Bentaleb. It’s played down the right to Saka, whose first touch is to pass into the middle, where Eze’s shot deflects (I think) past Ozer.
65 mins: Arsenal make their triple substitution, with Madueke, Merino and Gyokeres going off for Saka, Odegaard and Havertz.
65 mins: Madueke plays the ball into Timber, inside the penalty area but with his back to goal, whose first touch takes him past Andre, and whose second dinks it over Ozer. That really is very good.
Arsenal take the lead thanks to a lovely piece of work from Jurrien Timber!
63 mins: Lille haven’t got out of their half since the break. They’ve been appalling in possession, but still defensively and organisationally excellent.
62 mins: Arteta has seen enough, and is readying Havertz, Saka and Odegaard for an imminent triple change.
61 mins: Guimaraes attempts a 360-degree penalty-area pirouette. Sure, he loses the ball, but those dancing feet!
60 mins: Guimaraes runs into the area and goes down, and this time Arsenal are interested. But the referee is not, and neither is VAR.
59 mins: Lille take too long over a defensive throw-in, and it gets handed to Arsenal. But again, nothing comes of it.
57 mins: It may be time for Arsenal to utilise their bench – the only thing that’s really changed since half-time is the amount of grumbling coming from the crowd.
54 mins: Arsenal keep the ball for a while, but the closer they get to goal the less keen they seem to be to reach it.

52 mins: Madueke catches Perraud, who goes down, smacking the turf with a palm in apparent agony. So the referee blows his whistle, at which point Perraud’s agony magically evaporates, and he gets up.
51 mins: Arsenal do appear to have been instructed to get a move on, and the ball is zipping about with a bit more pace. Which is promising.
49 mins: Guimaraes takes the first shot of the second half, but it’s not very good, and floats harmlessly high and wide.
48 mins: … but that doesn’t lead to anything more than a goal kick.
47 mins: The first half ended(ish) with a couple of Arsenal corners and the second half has started similarly. This time they’re also going to get a third, which Rice is going to take.
46 mins: Peeeeeeep! Arsenal get the ball re-rolling.
The players are back out at the Emirates, with no halftimely changes.
Also in the Champions League tonight:
Atletico Madrid 1-0 Manchester United
Galatasaray 1-1 Barcelona Viking 2-0 Bayern Munich Lens 0-2 Sporting Sabah 2-0 Slavia Prague Internazionale 1-1 Club Brugge RB Leipzig 0-0 PSV Villarreal 2-1 Napoli

Arsenal have had two excellent chances, one created with a move down the right which ended with Guimaraes shooting wide, and one created with a move down the left which ended with Eze having a shot saved. They’ve been the better team, but Lille have been well organised and hard working, and goalless it remains.
45+1 mins: Save! Guimaraes’s deflected shot bamboozles Ozer, who can’t hold on to it and has to dive again to claw the ball off the toes of Gyokeres and out for a corner.
45 mins: … and his second attempt is cleared.
44 mins: Madueke takes the corner, which is headed behind for another corner.
43 mins: Madueke backheels into the path of the overlapping Timber, but he can’t pick out Gyokeres with his low cross, which is turned behind.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳 3-0 里尔：欧冠比赛实况
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳苦战一小时后，在下半场八分钟内连入三球击败里尔。
bodyZh: 好啦，我的播报就到这里。再见！在我离开之前，再次附上埃德·阿隆斯的比赛报道：
作为临别赠礼，这里有西德·洛维关于曼联在马德里竞技失利的文章：
埃贝雷奇·埃泽对这场比赛进行了总结：
“表现不错。我们完成了需要做的事，踢得很放松并享受其中，这才是最重要的。很多球队来这里时都带着极高的斗志，所以上半场可能会相当艰难，但我们的目标是把对手慢慢磨垮。”
埃德·阿隆斯的比赛报道出炉了！
连胜场次延续到了十二场。在这个阿森纳缅怀俱乐部终身主席肯·弗里尔的夜晚——正是他在2006年促成了球队从海布里搬迁至酋长球场——米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队在已经成为堡垒的主场又创造了一个欧冠里程碑，这再合适不过了。
近年来阿森纳在这里的统治力如此之强，以至于当萨卡面对顽强的里尔攻入第三球时，这是自三年前阿尔特塔率队重返欧洲顶级赛场以来，他们在联赛或小组赛中于酋长球场打进的第36个进球。
这里有更多内容：
在我们等待比赛报告的同时，这里有一篇关于英格兰女足在世界杯附加赛中5-0大胜希腊的报道：
今晚欧冠比赛的完整比分：
阿森纳 3-0 里尔 马德里竞技 2-0 曼联 加拉塔萨雷 1-4 巴塞罗那 国际米兰 3-4 布鲁日俱乐部 朗斯 0-2 里斯本竞技 RB莱比锡 1-0 埃因霍温 萨巴赫 2-0 布拉格斯拉维亚 维京 3-3 拜仁慕尼黑* 比利亚雷亚尔 3-1 那不勒斯
* 这里戏剧性十足：维京半场2-0领先，在迈克尔·奥利斯于第73分钟累计两张黄牌被罚下后以2-3落后，但他们在最后一分钟抢下了一个绝平球。
打破里尔防线的尤里恩·廷贝尔接受了采访：
“我在上半场有过一些机会。第一脚停球不错，这就完成了一半工作。然后诺尼在喊‘射门！射门！射门！’，所以我射门了。我没有想太多。我当时只想着‘我得射门’。我们需要那个首开纪录的进球。我们踢得不错，但我们需要那个进球。我们知道自己有多强。上半场我们有一些机会，踢得有点草率，但我们一直掌控着局面。我们只需继续前进。赛季还处于早期。”
90+4分钟：全场比赛结束！八分钟内的三粒进球帮助阿森纳战胜了防守组织出色但最终实力不济的里尔，里尔在下半场频繁丢球，付出了代价。
90+2分钟：哈弗茨对门将进行了一次有些过热的逼抢，在完成解围的后续动作中带倒了门将，被出示黄牌。
90+1分钟：进入伤停补时，大约会有三分钟左右。
90分钟：厄德高在拥挤的禁区内给多曼送出一记精妙的直传。虽然没有形成结果，但同样非常精彩。
88分钟：与此同时，在马德里，曼联落后两球且少一人作战。
85分钟：阿森纳用马克斯·多曼换下埃泽。
84分钟：阿森纳以散步般的节奏踢球，这在前一个小时的大部分时间里他们也差不多是这样，但现在感觉没那么让人恼火了。
82分钟：里尔用索里巴·迪亚乌内换下巴克瓦。
81分钟：戈菲因对埃泽犯规吃到黄牌，这次铲球非常糟糕，但还没严重到需要更严厉处罚的地步。
78分钟：当吉鲁替补上场换下上田时，得到了今晚迄今为止第四响亮的欢呼声。卡尔文·韦尔多恩替补上场换下佩罗，阿森纳则用本·怀特换下廷贝尔。
77分钟：里尔在距离自家球门40码处再次丢球，阿森纳形成四打二的局面，本应取得进球。但吉马良斯无意传球，而是在25码处起脚射门，被厄泽扑出。
77分钟：据说奥利维尔·吉鲁即将迎来他的高光时刻。
76分钟：场上没有约克雷斯对阿森纳的影响非常大。
73分钟：里尔险些获得机会！赖斯认为自己被犯规，但裁判示意比赛继续，皮球从右侧传到中路给巴克瓦，孔萨奋不顾身地挡出了他的射门。
73分钟：里尔换下本塔莱布和穆考，换上萨赫拉维和克亚尔高。
我经历过这场比赛还觉得悬念丛生的年代。三名替补球员联手制造了这个进球：厄德高在禁区右侧传给哈弗茨，哈弗茨回敲给萨卡，萨卡推射球门远角破门！
70分钟：扑救！阿森纳现在几乎势不可挡。萨卡从右侧的传中险些让赖斯抢到，几秒钟后埃泽突入禁区左侧，但厄泽伸手挡出了他的射门。
阿森纳扩大了领先优势，这个进球之所以格外美妙，是因为球是由前热刺中场球员纳比勒·本塔莱布“礼让”给他们的。皮球被传给右路的萨卡，萨卡的第一脚触球是传中到中路，埃泽的射门（我想）发生了折射后越过厄泽入网。
65分钟：阿森纳进行三人换让，马杜埃凯、梅里诺和约克雷斯下场，萨卡、厄德高和哈弗茨替补登场。
65分钟：马杜埃凯将球传给背身拿球的廷贝尔，廷贝尔的第一脚触球晃过安德烈，第二脚轻巧地挑射越过厄泽。这真的非常精彩。
凭借尤里恩·廷贝尔的精彩表现，阿森纳取得领先！
63分钟：里尔自中场休息以来就没能攻出本方半场。他们在控球方面表现糟糕，但在防守和战术组织上依然极其出色。
62分钟：阿尔特塔已经看够了，正准备让哈弗茨、萨卡和厄德高进行一次即时的三换。
61分钟：吉马良斯在禁区内尝试了一次360度旋转。当然，他丢了球，但那双脚的盘带太灵巧了！
60分钟：吉马良斯带球突入禁区倒地，这一次阿森纳队员提出了抗议。但裁判没有理会，VAR也没有介入。
59分钟：里尔在处理一个防守界外球时耗时太久，球被判给了阿森纳。但同样，什么也没创造出来。
57分钟：或许是阿森纳利用替补席的时候了——自中场休息以来唯一真正改变的，是看台上传出的抱怨声大小。
54分钟：阿森纳控球了一段时间，但他们离球门越近，似乎就越不想真正攻过去。
52分钟：马杜埃凯放倒了佩罗，后者倒地，手掌猛击草皮，显得痛苦万分。于是裁判吹响了哨子，就在此时，佩罗的痛苦神奇地消失了，他站了起来。
51分钟：阿森纳似乎得到了加快节奏的指示，皮球带着更高的速度来回传递。这很有希望。
49分钟：吉马良斯完成了下半场的首次射门，但质量不高，高高飞出底线，没有构成威胁。
48分钟：……但最终只赢得了一个球门球。
47分钟：上半场以几个阿森纳角球结束，下半场也以类似的方式开局。这一次他们还将获得第三个角球，由赖斯主罚。
46分钟：哔——！阿森纳重新开球。
球员们回到了酋长球场，中场休息时双方均未做出人员调整。
今晚的其他欧冠比赛情况：
马德里竞技 1-0 曼联
加拉塔萨雷 1-1 巴塞罗那 维京 2-0 拜仁慕尼黑 朗斯 0-2 里斯本竞技 萨巴赫 2-0 布拉格斯拉维亚 国际米兰 1-1 布鲁日俱乐部 RB莱比锡 0-0 埃因霍温 比利亚雷亚尔 2-1 那不勒斯
阿森纳有过两次绝佳机会，一次是通过右路配合由吉马良斯射门偏出，另一次是通过左路配合由埃泽的射门被扑出。他们是表现更好的一方，但里尔组织严密且拼抢积极，比分依然是平局。
45+1分钟：扑救！吉马良斯的折射射门让厄泽措手不及，他没能将球抱住，不得不再次倒地从约克雷斯脚下将球解围出底线。
45分钟：……他的第二次尝试被解围了。
44分钟：马杜埃凯主罚角球，皮球被头球解围出底线，又是一个角球。
43分钟：马杜埃凯脚后跟传球给前插的廷贝尔，但他的低平球传中没能找到约克雷斯，球被挡出底线。

bodyEn: Twelve wins in a row and counting. On a night when Arsenal remembered Ken Friar – the club’s life president who was instrumental in their move from Highbury to the Emirates in 2006 – it was fitting that Mikel Arteta’s side should rack up yet another Champions League milestone at their home that has become a fortress.

Such has Arsenal’s dominance been here in recent seasons that when Bukayo Saka slotted home their third against a dogged Lille side, it was the 36th goal they have scored at the Emirates in the league or group stage since returning to Europe’s top table under Arteta three years ago. In those 12 wins, they have remarkably conceded only three times.

Arsenal have also now racked up 14 successive league-stage victories in this competition – three short of Bayern Munich’s record – even if Arteta’s side were made to work for this one and had to wait until the 64th minute to find the breakthrough. That came from the unlikely source of Jurriën Timber after Arsenal’s second-string attack – and Viktor Gyökeres in particular – had looked laboured. But while Arteta may be concerned that it needed the introduction of Saka from the bench along with Martin Ødegaard and Kai Havertz to put this game to bed as Eberechi Eze added a second before Saka rounded off the scoring with a third in the space of seven minutes, they never looked in any danger of losing their proud record as Olivier Giroud received a standing ovation on his return to north London.

“I’m sure he is very happy to see how the boys played. But not only that, because I know how proud he felt about what we built,” said Arteta of Friar. “It’s a really sad day for everyone who loves football. The legacy that Ken is going to leave for this club is going to be for ever.”

Arsenal had earlier paid tribute to Friar, who worked his way up from the box office to club secretary before becoming managing director in the 1980s, when his death at the age of 92 was confirmed. The players wore black armbands as a mark of respect. Friar would have been especially proud of their formidable record here under Arteta in this competition that stretches back to the 2023-24 season, when they returned to the tournament after an absence of six years. It is little wonder that Arteta was so reluctant for redevelopment plans to go ahead given the disruption any temporary move away to Wembley or elsewhere would have caused.

Despite the absence of Piero Hincapié and Martín Zubimendi after they were both injured during the warm-down after the victory over Leeds on Saturday, the Arsenal manager was still able to make five changes. Lille’s manager, Davide Ancelotti, who worked under his father, Carlo, at Everton and Real Madrid among others before being appointed during the summer in only his second senior role, resisted the temptation to start with 40-year-old Giroud against his former club.

Restored to his favoured right flank after excelling on the left against Leeds, it had not been saying much that Noni Madueke had once again been Arsenal’s most dangerous outlet in a first half in which they struggled to create much against a deep-lying defence.

Bruno Guimarães and then Mikel Merino spurned decent chances, while Ayase Ueda had the ball in David Raya’s net after Nabil Bentaleb’s shot deflected off Timber and hit Hákon Haraldsson on the way through, with the video assistant referee confirming the Japan striker was marginally offside.
But Arsenal lacked creativity without Ødegaard and Gyökeres showing plenty of hustle and bustle yet making little real impact.

It summed Arsenal’s first half up when he could not get out of the way after Eze forced Berke Ozer into his first proper save and was promptly flagged offside. Ozer then had to scramble the ball away from the feet of the Sweden striker after spilling a shot from Guimarães on the stroke of half-time.

The referee, Felix Zwayer, waved away appeals at the start of the second half when Guimarães went down in the area under pressure from Alexsandro but the Arsenal midfielder seemed to be looking for the contact. A wayward effort that almost made it into the upper tier from Madueke was the signal for Arteta to summon Ødegaard, Saka and Havertz to get ready.

Before they had time to be introduced, Arsenal finally found the breakthrough when Madueke picked out Timber to apply a deft finish with his right foot after a brilliant first touch. Saka made an immediate impact by setting up Eze to dispatch the second with his left foot – possibly with the help of a deflection – less than three minutes later, before adding a third after combining with Havertz and Ødegaard. Lille must have wondered what had hit them.

As well as the chance to pay their respects to Giroud, the Arsenal fans were treated to a late cameo from the dazzling Max Dowman to round off another very satisfying evening that has become the norm.
